jobs.title: Web Dev Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join Our Dynamic Team as a Web Development Project Manager : Help Empower Healthcare Professionals Worldwide!

Location:
Lebanon – Remote
Employment:
Full-time
Working Hours:
10:00 am – 6:00 pm Sydney time
Compensation: Up to US$2,500 per month
depending on experience and assessment.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced, highly organized and proactive Web Development Project Manager
to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced digital environment, enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and knows how to keep multiple projects, people and deadlines moving at the same time. You will be responsible for coordinating projects across different teams, monitoring progress, identifying potential delays and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who does more than simply update tasks. You should be comfortable taking ownership of projects from start to finish
, following up with team members, solving problems and escalating risks before they become issues.

Please note:
We are looking for candidates with web development project management experience
— this is a priority for the role. Experience in a digital marketing agency
is also highly preferred.

What You Will Do

Manage multiple projects simultaneously from planning through to completion.
Develop clear project timelines, milestones, priorities and deliverables.
Coordinate work across different teams, including design, development, marketing, content and other operational functions.
Assign and monitor tasks and ensure team members understand their responsibilities and deadlines.
Conduct regular project follow-ups and ensure outstanding tasks continue moving forward.
Identify bottlenecks, dependencies and potential delays early and take action to resolve them.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within our project management systems.
Monitor deadlines and ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines.
Communicate project progress, risks, delays and required decisions clearly to management.
Run project meetings and ensure actions, owners and deadlines are clearly documented.
Follow up with team members on outstanding deliverables and hold stakeholders accountable for agreed deadlines.
Work closely with management to prioritize projects and allocate resources effectively.
Improve existing workflows, processes and project management systems.
Develop and maintain project documentation, SOPs and reporting where required.
Ensure completed work meets project requirements before projects are considered complete.

What We Require

Minimum 4 years of professional website development project management experience.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Strong experience working with cross-functional teams.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate project records.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong communication skills and confidence following up with team members and stakeholders.
Ability to identify problems early and propose practical solutions rather than simply escalating issues.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Technically fluent in dev workflows, including sprint planning, QA processes, and coordinating between design, development, and client teams.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Experience using project management platforms such as Monday.com, Asana, ClickUp, Jira or similar
.
Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Docs and Drive.

Highly Regarded

Experience working in a digital marketing agency, technology company or similar fast-paced digital environment
.
Experience managing website, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising, design or development projects.
Experience with Monday.com
.
Experience managing remote or internationally distributed teams.
Experience developing processes, workflows and SOPs.
Project management qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or Scrum certification
.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role if:
Projects are delivered on time and important deadlines are rarely missed.
Management has clear visibility over the status of every project.
Team members know exactly what they are responsible for and when it is due.
Delays and bottlenecks are identified before they become major problems.
Project information is accurate and consistently maintained.
You actively drive projects forward rather than waiting for others to provide updates.
Processes become more organized and efficient as a result of your involvement.

The Person We're Looking For

You don't need to be reminded to follow something up. If a deadline is approaching, you already know about it and are working with the relevant person to make sure it is delivered.
You are comfortable asking questions, challenging unrealistic timelines and holding people accountable while maintaining positive working relationships.
Most importantly, you have a strong ownership mentality
. When a project is assigned to you, you take responsibility for moving it forward and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Meaningful perks that reflect our commitment:

Competitive salary, inclusive of a monthly retention bonus.
Remote position (work from anywhere)
, full-time, and long-term
Annual compensation review
Fitness subsidy for 12 months to support your well-being.
Birthday leave, so you can celebrate and enjoy your special day off!
We observe local public holidays, allowing team members to rest and celebrate their national holidays.
15 days of Paid time off, ensuring team members have time to relax and recharge.
Global exposure and friendly work environment
Opportunity to learn new techniques & tools with a young and dynamic team
Lead performance with autonomy and visibility across departments.
Remote-first, collaborative culture that values initiative and outcomes.

Our Commitment

Mediboost is proudly an equal-opportunity employer.
We celebrate diversity, welcome individuality, and create a space where every voice is heard and valued.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Summary

A Project Manager at MediaNews Group is responsible for the flow of work through product development and acts as a servant leader and coach for an agile team. You will lead the team via agile practices, ensuring that the agreed-upon process is followed. You will also remove impediments and foster high-performing team dynamics, continuous flow, and constant improvement. In a larger project management context, you will be responsible for balancing the competing needs of scope, schedule, and cost, while uncovering and monitoring risks. Finally, the Project Manager keeps stakeholders apprised of the status of a project or ongoing product development and is highly visible throughout the organization.

We are looking for a confident leader who thrives in dynamic environments, embraces change, and enjoys solving complex problems. You will be running a scrum team and playing the role of project manager on a larger program as needed. The ideal candidate isn't afraid of deadlines, can assert themselves when necessary, and isn't shy about addressing tough issues when they arise. Everyone on our team is a hands-on contributor, so be ready to roll up your sleeves and make an impact.

Although this is a remote role, candidates must reside in CO, FL, IL, MA, MN, OH, OK, PA, or TX.

What You Will Do

Apply agile and occasional waterfall methodologies and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices to initiatives from idea to launch and beyond, while ensuring alignment with SDLC standards and company strategy
Lead all aspects of the project, including planning, execution, timely delivery, functionality, quality, issue tracking, and communication
Maintain accountability for project delivery to the PMO, business owner, and stakeholders
Create initial project planning documentation, including assumptions/constraints, measures of success, quality measures, risks, mitigation plans, issues, dependencies, schedules, and change control strategy
Report progress, risks, and issues to management and project stakeholders; track risks, risk mitigation, known issues, change requests, and change impact in writing, and work to resolve blockers to completion
Use tracking tools to provide status and progress updates
Contribute to quarterly planning, Scrum of Scrums, all other agile ceremonies, and the project management community of practice
Lead by facilitation using standard scrum and scaled agile methodologies
Enforce the priorities of the work to be performed, as determined with the product owner, business owner, and project stakeholders; obtain product manager and client sign-off on key project deliverables
Conduct post-project reviews, lessons-learned discussions, and retrospectives
Draft and create project archives and process improvement plans based on lessons learned and retrospectives; implement approved plans
Add project documentation to the repository for use in future projects

What You Will Bring

Project management platform familiarity (Jira, Trello, Asana, etc.)
Web technology platform knowledge preferred
Experience in digital media strongly preferred
Agile project management training and at least 2 years of experience
Previous project management experience
PMP or CSM certification preferred

Benefits And Compensation

The salary range is $100,000 - $125,000. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to geographic location, education, work experience, time in role, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, the Company offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, life and disability insurance, 401k, as well as paid time off and select paid holidays (all benefits are based on eligibility). Please click the following link for more detailed information: www.mymedianewsgroup.com

Who We Are

MediaNews Group is a leading local news provider and digital marketing partner, with a 175+ year history dedicated to delivering impactful journalism and advertising that informs, inspires, and engages readers across diverse, local communities. With a portfolio of 77 daily and over 150 weekly publications nationwide, our products reach 47.2 million readers monthly with essential local news and information, including through brands such as: The Denver Post, San Jose's The Mercury News, Boston Herald, Saint Paul Pioneer Press, The Orange County Register, and more. The Product & Technology team's mission is to create people-centric digital technology that empower our local news and partners by putting people, product, and performance first. Our team builds product experiences across MediaNews Group's entire digital portfolio, including local news publications and the Adtaxi digital marketing agency. At MediaNews Group, you’ll join a team that values expertise, continuous learning, and autonomy, while embracing business agility through decentralized decision-making and scaled agile principles.

“4x Built In Best Places to Work Winner - 2023-2026”

EEO Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

How To Apply

Please submit an online application along with your resume for this position here

Closing Date

Continuous recruitment until the position is filled

Conditions Of Employment

A full pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Must be willing to submit and pass the necessary required checks

jobs.title: Senior NetSuite Project Manager
jobs.description:
This is a full-time, remote role for LatAm candidates only.

As a Senior NetSuite Project Manager at our client's team, you will take ownership of client success across NetSuite ERP and custom engagements. This is a high-visibility, client-facing role for an accountable project leader who can bridge the gap between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure seamless solution delivery.

Operating within the Pacific Time Zone, you will lead high-profile implementations from kickoff through rollout, driving stakeholder alignment, risk management, and delivery excellence at every step.

Responsibilities:

Liaison with clients on an ongoing basis, to maintain and develop the business relationship, and keep projects to a set time frame
Actively manage stakeholders; expectations, resource alignment, and possible conflicting priorities across projects
Ensure adherence to Plative delivery structure and project management methodology during implementation of the solution
Deliver strategic business and project reviews to educate clients on proposed solutions
Communicate reports regarding budget ownership, project status, risk management and escalation of issues
Coordinate IT project teams to ensure that client business requirements are effectively incorporated into design specifications, multi-platform integrations and data transfers
Be a client advocate to resolve and manage escalations to ensure client satisfaction
Work on NetSuite related projects including new implementations, enhancements, integrations, support and ownership of SFDC build out
Create and deliver presentations on technical concepts, project work plans, delivery approach, milestones, and results to client stakeholders

Basic Qualifications

Full, life-cycle implementation experience with NetSuite across multiple industry verticals
3+ years Project Management experience and within consulting environment
At least 4 years of hands-on experience with NetSuite implementations
Demonstrated expertise in Negotiation, Vendor Management, Risk Management, Project Financials, KPI & Reporting
Solid understanding of Quality Management principles and practices

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Computer Science, IT or MBA
Delivered numerous complex NetSuite projects
CSM and SuiteFoundation certifications

About RYZ Labs:

RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world.

Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting-edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries, planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years.

At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists.

Our values and what to expect:

Customer First Mentality - every decision we make should be made through the lens of the customer
Bias for Action - urgency is critical, expect that the timeline to get something done is accelerated
Ownership - step up if you see an opportunity to help, even if not your core responsibility
Humility and Respect - be willing to learn, be vulnerable, and treat everyone that interacts with RYZ with respect
Frugality - being frugal and cost-conscious helps us do more with less
Deliver Impact - get things done in the most efficient way
Raise our Standards - always be looking to improve our processes, our team, our expectations. Status quo is not good enough and never should be

jobs.title: Project Manager - Rebar
jobs.description:
A position at White Cap isn’t your ordinary job. You’ll work in an exciting and diverse environment, meet interesting people, and have a variety of career opportunities.

The White Cap family is committed to Building Trust on Every Job. We do this by being deeply knowledgeable, fully capable, and always dependable, and our associates are the driving force behind this commitment.

Job Summary

Responsible for overseeing the execution of rebar projects from the set-up phase through completion.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities And Key Accountabilities

Provide total contract management of each project assigned, including coordination of the detailing, scheduling, delivery and costs of products and services.
Oversee the customer and project team in establishing the sequential steps involved in all processes with the scope of the project and adapt schedules and work tasks accordingly.
Communicate with customers regarding project details involving detailing, fabrication and delivery issues.
Review rebar shop drawings and direct the revision of drawings as needed.
Schedule the detailing and delivery of required products and services with the contractor, detailers, and production team.
Answer customer questions related to assigned projects and resolve any problems that may occur.
Perform special projects and complete all other duties as assigned or requested for the support of the organization.

Nature and Scope

Identifies key barriers/core problems and applies problem solving skills in order to deal creatively with complex situations. Troubleshoots and resolves complex problems. Makes decisions under conditions of uncertainty, sometimes with incomplete information, that produce effective end results.
Independently performs assignments with instruction limited to the expected results. Determines and develops an approach to solutions. Receives technical guidance only on unusual or complex problems or issues.
May oversee the completion of projects and assignments, including planning, assigning, monitoring and reviewing progress and accuracy of work, evaluating results, etc. Contributes to employees' professional development but does not have hiring or firing authority.

Work Environment

Typically located in a comfortable indoor area. There may be regular exposure to mild physical discomfort from factors, such as dust, fumes or odors, temperature extremes, loud noise, strong drafts, or bright lights.
Frequent periods are spent standing or sitting in the same location with some opportunity to move about. Occasionally there may be a requirement to stoop or lift light material or equipment (typically less than 8 pounds).
Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

Education And Experience

Typically requires BS/BA in a related discipline. Generally 5-8 years of experience in a related field OR MS/MA and generally 3-5 years of experience in a related field. Certification is required in some areas.

Preferred Qualifications

Associate's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineer, Construction Management, related degree and/or equivalent work experience.
2 + years of project management experience and 1 + year of construction project management experience.
Basic knowledge of AutoCad or MicroStation.
Ability to read & understand structural & architectural drawings.
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills combined with the ability to meet deadlines and mult-task in fast-paced environment.

If you’re looking to play a role in building America, consider one of our open opportunities. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Commissioning Program Manager
jobs.description:
For over 45 years, CEQEL Critical Commissioning (CCCx) has been at the forefront of mission-critical commissioning services. Our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement has made us a trusted partner for complex facilities across various industries.

We combine decades of experience with cutting-edge technology to deliver reliable, efficient, and compliant commissioning services that meet the evolving needs of mission-critical environments.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:

Commissioning Program Manager

Position Location:

Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Travel Requirements:

Up to 75% travel for first 6 months then transition to 25%. Must have valid driver's license and ability to rent vehicles

Job Summary

The Commissioning Program Manager provides technical support and leadership to plan, schedule and execute full life cycle commissioning of hyperscale data centers / mission critical facilities on a programmatic basis. This person participates in the MEP design review process and participates in functional testing of complex electrical and mechanical systems, with a focus on higher level programmatic details.

The Commissioning Program Manager is responsible for supporting all aspects of the project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owners, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.

The role includes developing and evaluating bid proposals, developing commissioning plans and schedules, facilitating communication and ensuring compliance with owner’s requirements, applicable laws and specifications.

The Commissioning Program Manager will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. May coordinate activities of other personnel.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Manage all Elements of Commissioning Program(s) (45%)

Manage pre-construction elements including project initiation, kickoff, RFIs and submittals
Coordinate / oversee resource and material forecasting across all projects
Develop, manage and monitor schedules
Participate in, schedule and lead project meetings as necessary
Coordinate / oversee / perform the QA / QC of Cx plans and deliverables to ensure completion in accordance with the projects’ scope and appropriate guidelines and manuals
Communicate and coordinate project staffing needs; ensure compliance with program needs
Coordinate or oversee start-up, cutover, pre-functional or functional testing and project closeout
Assist / Guide the onboarding of the project team for mobilization
Prepare project / program progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
Develop testing plans and procedures for complex projects
Develop consolidated programmatic schedules for proposed work with the assistance of project teams

M onitor and Control Project Financials (15%)

Prepare, forecast and monitor project budgets, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization and maintain overall responsibility for the profitability of the project
Communicate with the client when additional fees / change orders are required
Identify potential project risks and develop / implement strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines
Monitoring the development of cost schedules / schedules of value for client progress billing

Manage Stakeholder Relations (30%)

Prepare proposals, presentations and the overall marketing efforts of the firm
Promotion of the firm, service and expertise to existing or potential clients
Maintain client relationships to ensure an ongoing positive relationship and work with clients to identify and develop new projects
Primary contact for clients and build effective, long-term client relationships
Ensure client satisfaction through active communication

Development and Continuous Improvement (10%)

Mentor associates and assist with training and development to create a learning and growing environment
Contribute to organizational training and standards development
May assist in the strategic planning for the group
May assist with hiring process

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (advanced Level For All The Following)

Knowledge of industry trends, project management and construction procedures and best practices
Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, leadership technique, and coordination of people and resources
Knowledge of materials, methods, and the tools involved in the construction mission critical, commercial buildings, or other structures
Knowledge of the importance of the Method of Procedure (MOP) process and work notifications
Skilled at using construction management software such as Procore
Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
Skilled at managing personnel and material resources
Ability to learn client and / or industry specific management software
Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports, and correspondence
Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with onsite and remote team members
Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
Ability to analyze complex information and develop plans to address identified issues
Proficient at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools
Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces
During initial training, the employee is
Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment
On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

Up to 75% travel for first 6 months – initial training / onboarding of program and projects
After first 6 months transition to 25% travel
Travel may include travel to any or all 50 US states
Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction or related discipline

OR

Two years of additional experience in related field in lieu of degree

PLUS

Minimum eight years of experience in related field
Minimum of five years of experience managing mid to large scale construction, engineering, or manufacturing projects

Benefits

Ceqel Critical Commissioning offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
Flex spending accounts (FSA)
Dental and vision plans
Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is Ceqel Critical Commissioning's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

Notice To Third Party Agencies

Ceqel Critical Commissioning does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to Ceqel Critical Commissioning in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where Ceqel Critical Commissioning has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of Ceqel Critical Commissioning and Ceqel Critical Commissioning will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

133,000 - 173,000 USD per year (Remote (United States))

jobs.description:
Trusted Connectivity for AI-Powered Dominance.

Everfox delivers trusted connectivity to protect the world’s most critical environments and safeguard the sensitive data powering decision advantage.

Built for mission-critical operations, Everfox protects what matters most by securing how data moves, how users access it, and how threats are neutralized across every domain. We enable mission speed and secure collaboration across networks, domains, and allies, while ensuring the data powering AI and advanced analytics remains trusted and protected.

We don’t just defend systems; we deliver decision dominance.

Our Purpose. Protect what matters most by enabling organizations to operate security in the most complex and high-risk digital environments.
Our Vision. To be the most trusted authority in high-assurance cybersecurity, enabling secure collaboration across every domain.
Our Belief. Security should never limit mission success – it should enable it.

Our Promise.
We deliver absolute confidence in environments where failure is not an option.

TITLE: Defense Tech - Project Manager PMR Support

LOCATION: United States; flexible/remote with occasional travel to customer, partner, and company sites.

About The Role

The Defense Tech - Project Manager PMR Support is responsible for coordinating Program Management Review (PMR) activities and maintaining the operational rhythm for the Defense Tech tower within the Strategic Growth Office (SGO). This role supports growth initiatives by tracking commitments, consolidating status updates, preparing executive-level reporting, and ensuring program, partner, and opportunity activities are accurately reported and executed on schedule.

Position Summary

HIAS seeks a Associate Manager, Preferred Communities to support the resettlement and integration of refugees and other newcomers served through the HIAS network. The Associate Manager is responsible for the ongoing management and oversight of programs and services delivered by HIAS’ network of local resettlement affiliate partners, helping connect refugees to supportive institutions, essential services, and their new communities.

The Associate Manager oversees ORR Supplemental Funding provided through the Preferred Communities (PC) Program to ensure adequate resources are available to support particularly vulnerable refugee arrivals and strengthen the capacity of HIAS’ domestic affiliate network to support additional resettlement. The Associate Manager ensures compliance with current PC guidelines and high-quality programmatic reporting, oversees key aspects of PC budgets and program implementation, and provides ongoing training and technical assistance to affiliate partners to support high-quality service delivery.

Note, this position is based at our headquarters in Silver Spring, Maryland or our office in New York, New York, and we will consider a remote option for applicants who live outside of commuting distance to either of our offices and are based in other states in which we are registered (California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia).

The salary for this position is $75,000-90,000. This position is grant funded and the position is contingent on funding.

Essential Functions

Provides targeted technical assistance to HIAS affiliate partners and conducts assessments to identify service and resource gaps, strengthen program implementation, and support high-quality client services.
Oversees implementation of multiple PC program areas and funding streams, including cross-program coordination, workflow management, and alignment with ORR guidance.
Reviews budgets and approves invoices across PC funding streams, coordinates subaward processes with Grants Administration and Subaward teams.
Supports semi-annual and annual PC reporting to the federal funder, including compiling affiliate submissions, synthesizing network-wide narratives and data, and ensuring timely and compliant submissions through ORR systems.
Oversees PC data management and quality, including Apricot data oversight, dashboard reviews, RADS submissions, data consistency checks, outcome tracking, and other activities to assess progress toward program goals.
Conducts in-person and desk monitoring, prepares monitoring reports, and supports affiliate partners in addressing findings and strengthening program performance.
Develops and updates program standards, guidance, case management tools, training materials, and other resources to strengthen the quality and consistency of services across the affiliate network.
Contributes to evidence-based program design, continuous improvement, and innovation across Social Integration programs.
Serves as a liaison with government funders, national resettlement agencies, state government entities, technical assistance providers, and other partners within designated areas of responsibility.
Coordinates with affiliate partners to support continuity of client services during changes in service delivery, including office closures, new locations, and changes in service modality.
Supports the development and delivery of affiliate conferences, regional trainings, and other learning opportunities.
Provides support for other Social Integration program functions and priorities as needed, including during periods of increased workload or team transition.

Qualifications & Requirements

Undergraduate degree required; Master’s degree in Social Work or a related field is preferred.
5–7 years of relevant professional experience required.
Knowledge of and experience with the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program strongly preferred, including experience supporting refugees and immigrants through case management, community-based services, or other wraparound integration services.
Previous work experience at a national resettlement agency or local resettlement provider required.
Experience developing and delivering virtual and/or in-person trainings preferred.
Strong analytical skills, including experience using data to inform evidence-based decision-making; experience with statistical analysis preferred.

Experience using and managing online databases and data collection systems preferred.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Ability to travel within the U.S. as needed, approximately 3–6 times per year.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking an Implementation Manager, independently motivated and ready to make our high-functioning Implementation Team even better. As an Implementation Manager, you will be our new customers’ primary contact, overseeing the onboarding process from end-to-end. This is a multi-faceted set of responsibilities including requirements gathering, configuration of our SaaS products to meet those requirements, carrying out basic project management activities, and ensuring a smooth transition from sales to adoption. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including sales, product management, customer success, and technical support, to deliver exceptional client experiences and drive customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do

Client Onboarding: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during the onboarding process. Conduct kickoff meetings, gather business processes and resulting requirements, and provide expert guidance on best practices for implementing and configuring our SaaS products to meet their unique needs.

Project Management: Carry out basic project management activities, notably that the work you are delivering falls within the scope of the implementation, that there are well planned & reliable communications, that you continuously evaluate points of risk and opportunity, and providing customer advice and assistance with their change management.

Product Configuration: Customize system settings, workflows, and integrations to align with client requirements while using out-of-the-box functionality to minimize customizations whenever possible. Depending on the product you may also:

Work extensively in Excel to prepare data and carry out initial data load;
Write simple scripts;
Author ad hoc reports on behalf of the customer.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, product management, customer success, and technical support teams to ensure a seamless transition from the sales cycle to adoption. Foster strong relationships with internal stakeholders, using effective communication to influence product design and customer life-cycle to deliver a coherent, high quality, client experience.

Training and Documentation: Engage the project team to develop and deliver comprehensive training sessions to educate clients on the features and functionalities of our SaaS products. Create and maintain implementation documentation, user guides, and knowledge base articles to support clients throughout the onboarding process ensuring the customer’s complete adoption of their product.

Issue Resolution: Identify and address implementation challenges, working closely with internal teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues promptly. Escalate complex problems to appropriate departments and provide timely updates to clients, ensuring their concerns are addressed effectively.

Continuous Improvement: Actively contributes to the enhancement of implementation processes and methodologies.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience in a client-facing implementation role, preferably in the SaaS industry.
Strong understanding of software implementation processes, methodologies, and best practices.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport, effectively collaborate with clients and internal teams, and be able to take the lead in a workshop environment.
Technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn and navigate new software applications, and the ability to identify and address implementation challenges effectively.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills – high comfort level with Excel is a plus.
Design and documentation of reports generated from relational databases – ability to author reports (SSRS or PowerBI) a significant plus.
Experience with CRM, ERP, or other enterprise software implementations, particularly GovTech, is a plus.
Familiarity with Jira, Cloud Coach, Autotask, Asana, or similar software for project tracking and time management is a plus.

Location & Travel:

This position will be Remote in the USA. Incumbent in this role is expected to work PT Hours.

We believe the future of work is human + AI. At Euna Solutions, we encourage our team members to leverage AI tools to enhance creativity, efficiency, and decision-making. We’re looking for people who are curious about emerging technologies, eager to experiment, and committed to using AI responsibly to augment—not replace—their expertise.

If you enjoy exploring new ways to solve problems, learning continuously, and applying AI to make your work smarter and more impactful, you’ll thrive here.

Life at Euna Solutions

We're a team of builders, problem-solvers, and public sector champions. We've built a workplace around a straightforward idea: people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and not running on empty.

Here's What That Actually Looks Like

🏢 How we work

We're hybrid — three days a week in our Oakville or Atlanta offices, with standard hours on those days. What the remaining days look like depends on your role and your manager. We talk about it early in the process so there are no surprises on either side.

Twice a year, you get an extra day tacked onto a long weekend. Simple reason: people who take breaks do better work. Use it however you need.

🙌 Community is part of who we are

Our Engagement Committee finds meaningful ways to give back through time, donations, and shared expertise. We're invested in the places where our people actually live and work.

We give every employee up to eight hours a year to spend on causes that matter to them. We want you to show up for your community — and we make time for it.

You won't know all 600+ people — and that's okay. What matters is building real relationships with the people you work with every day. Our culture team creates consistent opportunities for that, so work doesn't feel isolating.

Whether you're going deep on AI, building expertise in government tech, or stepping into a bigger role, we invest in your development — through budget, mentorship, and real opportunity to move when you're ready.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Ring Video Platform
jobs.description:
Description

The Ring Video Platform Team innovates in the video streaming space for Ring cameras. We are passionate about helping customers see what matters at home, whenever they need to. Every day, millions of Ring devices stream, record and process video through services we build and operate. At that scale we hold ourselves to a high bar for reliability, latency, video quality and privacy.

We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to set how our organization plans and delivers its most critical, multi-year initiatives across cloud services, device firmware and mobile apps. You'll partner with senior engineering leaders, programs will escalate to you, and you'll present complex decisions and trade-offs clearly to leaders up to the executive level. You won't be writing production code. You will be expected to read architectures, data and code, with AI help, well enough to tell when a plan, estimate or status is technically wrong, and to test technical trade-offs with evidence.

At Ring, TPMs operate with AI-native fluency: AI tools are a core part of how you plan, execute, communicate and deliver. As a Principal TPM, you'll set the AI-native standards for how programs are run across the organization, decide which tools get built, extended or retired, and define the bar AI-generated output must meet before anyone acts on it. AI fluency that doesn't improve customer outcomes is not enough. You own every output you ship, AI-assisted or not.

Key job responsibilities

Program Strategy: Set the program execution vision for Video Platform and own the multi-year strategy for its most critical cross-org initiatives, balancing new customer experiences with reliability, privacy, security and cost.
Portfolio Direction: Own portfolio-level decisions. Greenlight or stop work against clear success metrics, and build the case for what the organization takes on next, not only how it gets delivered.
Delivery at Scale: Deliver through others. Your success is measured by what the organization ships, not by the programs you personally run. Remove systemic blockers across teams and organizations, and build mechanisms that make delivery faster and more predictable without depending on you.
Technical Judgment: Test plans, estimates and status against the data. Identify risks and opportunities in architectures, technical strategies and team structures, and make the case for the changes that let teams deliver independently.
Stakeholder Communication: Write narratives and decision documents that directors and VPs act on. Represent difficult trade-offs clearly in business reviews and escalations.
TPM Community: Mentor TPMs and engineers, and raise the standard for how programs are run across Ring.
AI-Native Practice: Design program workflows with AI embedded from the start, including automated status, risk detection, dependency tracking and reusable tooling the organization adopts. When a tool or method falls short, fix the tool or the method, not just its output.

A day in the life

You're shaping several of the organization's highest-priority programs at once. In a typical week you might frame a multi-year delivery strategy with engineering leaders, deep dive into an architecture review to test whether a plan holds up, use AI-generated portfolio views to spot cross-team risks before they become escalations, decide with leadership which initiative to accelerate and which to stop, and improve the agentic workflows the team uses to run its programs. You balance hands-on judgment with long-range planning, and you keep automating the routine so that you and the organization can focus on decisions, strategy and customer impact.

About The Team

The Ring Video Platform organization, based in Cambridge/London, builds and operates the cloud services that power Ring video, from the moment a camera starts streaming to when a customer watches it on their phone. We're a collaborative group of teams with deep expertise in video streaming and distributed systems. We invest heavily in how we build, including how we use AI to do it, and we care about spreading that expertise across the organization.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in technical product or program management
Experience working directly with engineering teams
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience in architectural design or system design independent of an architect
Experience in technical program management
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Demonstrated fluency with AI tools in daily work (writing, analysis, reporting, research)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in hands-on work managing complex technology projects
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience designing AI-assisted or agentic workflows that automate program management work, such as status reporting, risk detection or dependency tracking, and that other teams adopt
Experience setting standards for how AI-generated output is validated before decisions are made on it
Experience delivering programs that span cloud services, device firmware and mobile apps

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager II, AWS SMGS Ops, IDEAS
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the pioneer and recognized leader in Cloud Computing. Our web services provide a platform for IT infrastructure in-the-cloud that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world. These customers range from start-ups to leading web companies to Global 500 companies. The Sales, Marketing, and Global Services Operations (SMGS Ops) mission is to enable the AWS field (“sellers”) organization to be the most efficient and effective in the world. Our goal is to reduce inefficiencies and overall cost of sales while identifying opportunities to accelerate revenue growth. Our team delivers the platform, data, mechanism, and insights that drive new sales strategies to accelerate revenue growth and enhance seller and leader workflows.

Key job responsibilities

As the right candidate, you will possess a strong program management background, have demonstrated experience leading large projects, and have a well-rounded technical background. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done. As a TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. Ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. High judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent and leadership experience will help to succeed in this role.

About The Team

IDEAS — Insights, Data Engineering, Econometrics, Analytics & Science — is the organization within AWS SMGS Ops responsible for turning data into insights for the AWS Sales and Marketing business. The team builds and operates the data infrastructure, analytics, and data science capabilities that help leaders across AWS understand their business, make better decisions, and serve customers more effectively at global scale.

We build with both native AWS technology — including state-of-the-art Generative AI — and industry-standard products, pairing the best of each to move faster, work smarter, and continually raise the bar on what our data and insights can do.

It is a collaborative, intellectually curious, and fast-moving group that partners closely with stakeholders across the company.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

Basic Qualifications

1+ years of technical product or program management experience
2+ years of software development experience
1+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

Our DRIVE platform gives automakers, Tier 1 suppliers, and start-ups the power and flexibility to develop and deploy breakthrough AI systems for autonomous vehicles — today powering over 270 partners in the development of autonomous cars, trucks, shuttles, and taxis.

We are looking for a deeply technical and experienced Senior Technical Program Manager to join the NVIDIA DRIVE AV Platform team. You will lead a focused effort to productize groundbreaking solutions that will redefine transportation and the growing field of self-driving cars. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with dedicated multi-functional engineering teams across vehicle subsystems — software, hardware, validation, and systems — to integrate their work into our autonomous DRIVE SW platform, while achieving or exceeding all relevant NVIDIA and automotive standards and guidelines. What sets this role apart: you bring real software engineering depth, specifically in embedded systems and platform software, driving engineering teams with credibility, attention to detail, and AI automation. The work is exciting, impactful, and fast-paced. We have customers and competition.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead multiple, concurrent complex programs across the autonomous driving platform — from embedded platform bring-up through production release.
Drive new platform technologies across the full stack: embedded OS, platform drivers, middleware, sensor integration, and validation.
Run automotive software development and releases in a highly dynamic environment, maintaining quality across rapid release cadences.
Translate deep embedded and SW knowledge into actionable program structures — defining scope, roadmaps, schedules, and milestones.
Identify and resolve risks and issues that affect release scope, schedule, and quality, especially those spanning SW/HW boundaries.
Identify and lead multi-functional dependencies proactively, including those spanning global engineering teams.
Improve processes and procedures within the team; streamline day-to-day operations with an eye for scalable engineering workflow using AI.
Communicate regularly with team members to set shared expectations and provide timely updates on progress, risks, and decisions.

What We Need To See

BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
12+ years of proven experience, with at least 8 years in Technical Program Management driving software engineering programs and releasing commercial products.
Solid understanding of embedded systems software: OS fundamentals (Linux, QNX, or similar RTOS), platform drivers, sensor middleware, and SW/HW integration.
Strong technical competence to engage deeply with engineering teams, debug program-level issues, and make sound trade-off calls across SW and HW domains.
Consistent track record of delivering scalable, complex programs in fast-paced, multi-functional environments.
Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills — you can translate deep technical complexity into streamlined executive updates and drive alignment across large organizations.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

You have shipped embedded software in automotive, robotics, or a related domain to get software running reliably on constrained, safety-relevant hardware.
Direct experience in autonomous vehicle platform development, including ADAS software integration, sensor fusion stacks, or platform validation.
Familiarity with automotive-grade software standards (ISO 26262, ASPICE, or equivalent) and how they interact with program execution.
Background leading global programs across time zones with geographically distributed engineering teams.
Expertise in Agile and Scrum methodology; PMP or Scrum Master certification is a plus, with proficiency with Jira and PMP tools with agility and scale.

jobs.title: Security Technical Program Manager, Engineering Privacy & Access
jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Snap Engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of Snapchatters around the world, every day. We’re deeply committed to the well-being of everyone in our global community, which is why our values are at the root of everything we do. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.

We are seeking a Security Technical Program Manager (Security TPM) to help operate and scale the programs that protect Snap’s data, systems, identities, and customer experience.

This role serves as a portfolio-level program leader across Access and Privacy Engineering. You will turn ambiguous privacy and security priorities into clear operating models, roadmaps, controls, execution plans, and measurable outcomes. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Legal, Compliance, Security, and business teams to make the right work visible, actionable, and sustainable.

The role supports the full lifecycle of privacy and security risk: identifying signals, establishing ownership, defining requirements, prioritizing work, driving adoption, validating outcomes, and communicating decisions and residual risk to leadership

What you’ll do

Own the cross-functional privacy and data governance, translating strategy into priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans.
Build operating mechanisms for intake, prioritization, decision-making, escalation, dependency management, exceptions, and closure.
Drive privacy-by-design programs that define data use, retention, access, sharing, minimization, and control requirements early in the lifecycle.
Coordinate material reviews and clarify technical feasibility, required approvals, controls, decision rights, and ownership.
Lead complex, company-wide programs through rollout, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
Provide leadership visibility, resolve blockers, and automate program workflows where appropriate.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong understanding of privacy engineering, data governance, information security, and risk management.
Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs in privacy engineering, data governance, security, data, infrastructure, or platform environments.
Ability to connect technical and control requirements to business outcomes, customer experience, operational risk, and regulatory obligations.
Experience building operating models, governance mechanisms, roadmaps, metrics, decision frameworks, and leadership reporting in ambiguous domains.
Strong technical judgment, including the ability to evaluate trade-offs, clarify approval requirements, and distinguish facts, decisions, dependencies, and residual risk.
Track record of driving adoption of platforms, standards, controls, and processes across teams with varied incentives and maturity.
Excellent written and verbal communication, organization, prioritization, facilitation, and follow-through across long-running programs.
Collaborative leader who builds trust, resolves conflict, facilitates decisions, and mentors program managers.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
6+ years of experience in technical program management in the privacy engineering, compliance, risk management, or technical solution delivery domains
Demonstrated experience leading privacy engineering programs across multiple engineering or business organizations.
Demonstrated experience converting ambiguous requirements or risk signals into measurable execution plans and outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with privacy-by-design, data lifecycle governance, data classification, data inventories, data access, retention, deletion, or third-party data risk

Turbine and Generator Services (TGS) exists to provide programmatic engineering and technical support to the Regulated and Renewable Energy (RRE) fleet of turbines and generators. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About The Job You’re Considering

As a Senior Project/Programme Manager, you will lead the delivery of large, complex IT and technology projects and programmes for our public sector and other clients. You will be responsible for managing high-visibility deliveries across the full project lifecycle, from initiation to end-to-end delivery, ensuring successful outcomes in dynamic, multi-supplier and matrix environments.

You will provide strong leadership to multi-discipline and multi-supplier teams, foster a collaborative and high-performing culture, and engage with senior stakeholders to deliver value and drive continuous improvement.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

To be eligible for employment you must have the unrestricted right to work in the UK and be eligible for SC clearance (see more below). We do not offer sponsorship.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:

identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

Lead the delivery of large and complex IT/technology projects and programmes across the full project lifecycle (end-to-end), ensuring delivery to agreed scope, quality, time, and budget.
Provide strong leadership to multi-discipline and multi-supplier teams, motivating and guiding them to achieve high performance in matrix environments.
Develop and maintain project/programme schedules, establish delivery rhythms, manage risks and dependencies, and proactively remove blockers.
Build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders at all levels, including senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment and successful delivery.
Drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency through agile delivery practices and lessons learned.
Manage projects/programmes in line with budget(s), ensuring accurate forecasting, value delivery, and effective change control.
Demonstrate commercial acumen, including developing commercial proposals and working with various contract types (e.g., Time & Materials, fixed price).
Provide clear reporting and data to support communication with senior stakeholders and support decision-making.
Ensure deliverables meet quality standards appropriate to their stage and are completed on time.
Foster a productive, inclusive, and collaborative working environment that supports professional growth and innovation.

Your Skills And Experience

Proven experience delivering IT/technology projects and programmes at a senior level, ideally within large and complex environments, from end-to-end.
Demonstrated ability to manage large and complex projects/programmes across the full project lifecycle and end-to-end delivery.
Strong understanding of agile delivery practices, project/programme lifecycle management, and experience working in matrix and multi-supplier team environments.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience engaging with senior stakeholders.
Demonstrated leadership in motivating and guiding multi-discipline and multi-supplier teams to achieve high performance.
Experience managing projects/programmes in line with budget(s), ensuring accurate forecasting, value delivery, effective change control and active RAID ownership
Demonstrate financial acumen, including P&L accountability and budget management.
Proven ability to identify, assess, and proactively manage project and programme risks, implementing effective mitigation strategies and ensuring timely resolution of issues.
Exceptional planning skills, with a proven ability to develop robust project and programme plans that align with organisational objectives and ensure successful delivery.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini Is Proud To Be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) Under The UK Government’s Disability Confident Scheme. As Part Of Our Commitment To Inclusive Recruitment, We Will Offer An Interview To All Candidates Who

Declare they have a disability, and
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

jobs.description:
Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar - delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy.

Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact - both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best.

Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs.

Position Summary

Standard Operations Position. Provide end-to-end project management, leadership and coordination for large complex projects or as a part of a transformational project work stream with responsibility for project scope, schedule, cost and risk management. Ensure alignment of financial and operational goals between projects and the business unit. Provide work team direction to achieve approved project scope, develop strategic sequencing and detailed milestone schedules, project-level cost tracking and reconciliation. Ensure availability or seek out adequate resources for projects.

Essential Responsibilities

Financial Management: Function as project controller. Manage project financials including budgeting, forecasting, and actuals tracking. Facilitate RFP and contract management processes. Review actuals versus planned budget throughout project life cycle to identify variances and recommend corrective action. Ensure timely project closure, payment and reconciliation.
Project Planning: Lead requirements gathering and planning process for approved projects while engaging all key stakeholders. Develop solution design that defines the entire project scope, and secure all required internal/external approvals. Ensure coordination with other initiatives, assuring dependencies are identified and addressed. Define deliverables and required delivery dates; develop viable work plans/WBS, milestone schedules, and project cost/benefit estimates.
Project Management: Independently manage detailed project plans to approved scope and provide cross-functional tracking as needed. Identify plan gaps and develop closure plans. Ensure the successful completion of assigned project deliverables & milestones in a dynamic/complex environment.
Resource Management: Manage resources, both internal and external. Manage assigned contracts and associated payments and performance requirements. Develop and adapt a comprehensive resource plan for a matrixed team of diverse talent to maximize skills and minimize cost. Provide mentoring and guidance to less experienced project team members.
Scope & Risk Management: Manage scope change request process for project. Identify risks and issues throughout the project lifecycle and create mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
Relationship Management: Communicate project status to all levels of the organization. Establish effective, collaborative working relationships to maximize project efficiency, responsiveness and resource allocation.

Minimum Requirements

8 years work experience in operations, technology, finance, or comparable function.
Utility experience preferred.
BS Engineering, Construction, Business, Information Technology or related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
5 - 7 years' experience in project management and process improvement.
Some formal project management training preferred.
Demonstrated ability to lead and influence others, informal leadership experience and training skills preferred.
Strong presentation and facilitation skills; excellent written/verbal communications skills required.
Understanding of core business processes/ industry trends with ability to interpret/apply ongoing changes.
Knowledge of project planning and business need justification process and methodology.
Ability to adapt to change quickly and work within a diverse, cross-functional team environment.
Vendor/contract management experience preferred.

Preferred Requirements

Audit experience involving assurance and validation of adherence to security or regulatory standards.
NERC CIP experience.
Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) or TSA experience.

Our culture is grounded in shared values and employee commitments that guide how we work, support one another, and grow together.

Our Values

Connected, Committed, Trustworthy, Safe

Our Employee Commitments

Work that makes a difference
A team you can count of
Opportunities to grow
Rewards that help you thrive

Xcel Energy provides job applicants reasonable accommodations for disabilities throughout the application process. If you are in need of an accommodation to complete the application process, now or at any time in the future, please complete the Applicant Accommodation Request Form.

The anticipated starting base pay for this position is: $97,600.00 to $138,600.00 per year

This position is eligible for the following benefits: Annual Incentive Program, Medical/Pharmacy Plan, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Health Care Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account (HSA) (if enrolled in eligible health plan), Limited-Purpose FSA (if enrolled in eligible health plan and HSA), Transportation Reimbursement Account, Short-term disability (STD), Long-term disability (LTD), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Fitness Center Reimbursement (if enrolled in eligible health plan), Tuition reimbursement, Transit programs, Employee recognition program, Pension, 401(k) plan, Paid time off (PTO), Holidays, Volunteer Paid Time Off (VPTO), Parental Leave

Benefit plans are subject to change and Xcel Energy has the right to end, suspend, or amend any of its plans, at any time, in whole or in part.

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information including but not limited to dates of school attendance and graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
