Job Description

The Program Manager serves as a key administrative and operational lead for the Title III FUTURE Act Teacher Education Preparation Activity within the College of Education at Bowie State University. The Program Manager is responsible for coordinating, executing, and monitoring project operations directly tied to the objectives of the grant.

The position supports teacher candidate readiness for state licensure, coordinates professional learning systems for faculty, mentor teachers, and field supervisors, and manages systems for tracking clinical experiences, observations, assessment data, and candidate progress. The Program Manager works collaboratively with university staff, faculty, mentor teachers, field supervisors, district partners, and other stakeholders to support teacher preparation activities, monitor performance indicators, and facilitate successful completion of required assessments and clinical experiences.

Responsibilities

The Program Manager will:

Certification & Licensure Support
Coordinate the logistics, registration, and distribution of Praxis II and edTPA examination vouchers for eligible teacher candidates.
Assist in tracking student progress in course redesigns, Action Research projects, and licensure examination pass rates toward established target benchmarks.
Coordinate student registration, materials, and logistics for Praxis II preparation courses and edTPA workshops.
Organize Action Research presentation panels and support candidate presentation logistics.

Professional Learning System Coordination
Organize and schedule professional development workshops and learning modules for faculty, mentor teachers, and field supervisors.
Coordinate professional development activities addressing culturally responsive learning environments, artificial intelligence (AI) and digital learning technology in instruction, edTPA processes, Action Research guidance, and the Teach-Coach-Reflect model.
Coordinate administrative and travel logistics for faculty, mentor teachers, and candidates attending local and national conferences.
Manage contractual agreements and schedules for external trainers, consultants, and speakers.

Data Tracking, Assessment & Clinical Operations
Oversee the implementation of the student candidate progress tracking system to record, store, and evaluate performance metrics, including Praxis II scores, edTPA status, GPA, and research milestones.
Assist in piloting updated classroom observation tools and monitor implementation fidelity across clinical placements, including practicum, internship, and residency experiences.
Coordinate formative assessments, evaluation surveys, and feedback loops among teacher candidates, mentor teachers, and field supervisors.
Compile and analyze real-time performance data to generate quarterly and annual grant progress reports.
Develop and maintain organized systems for collecting, tracking, and communicating student assessment and performance information.
Provide support for assessment-related resources, systems, and activities designed to promote successful completion of required assessments.

Administrative & Financial Operations
Monitor project budget line items, including technology equipment, instructional books, and contractual arrangements, in accordance with Title III guidelines.
Order, inventory, and distribute project supplies, technology equipment, and instructional texts.
Maintain comprehensive grant records, participant logs, meeting minutes, and data artifacts for institutional evaluation and audit compliance.
Collaborate with university staff, faculty, district partners, field supervisors, mentor teachers, and other stakeholders to support grant activities and achieve established performance indicators.
Undertake other assignments as directed by the Department Chair, College of Education, Teaching, Learning & Professional Development.

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Master's degree in Education related fields required, Doctoral degree in Education related fields preferred.
Experience: Two to four years of experience in program management, grant administration, or higher education project coordination.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Demonstrated organizational, communication, project management, and problem-solving skills.
Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities, priorities, deadlines, and project activities.
Proficiency in data management, collection, tracking, analysis, and reporting tools, including Microsoft Excel and other applicable technology platforms.
Knowledge of and familiarity with educator certification standards, standardized testing, including Praxis II and edTPA, and K–12 clinical field placements.
Proficiency in organizing and coordinating training sessions, professional development workshops, learning modules, and student engagement activities related to teacher education and assessment.
Demonstrated ability to manage and maintain data tracking systems used to monitor academic, assessment, licensure, research, and clinical milestones.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate effectively with faculty, mentor teachers, field supervisors, students, university staff, district partners, external consultants, and other institutional stakeholders.
Ability to organize and coordinate clinical and field experience activities, including practicum, internship, and residency placements.
Demonstrated ability to create, implement, and evaluate professional development activities and learning opportunities.
Ability to collect, analyze, and communicate performance data for institutional and grant reporting purposes.
Ability to maintain accurate grant records, participant documentation, meeting minutes, data artifacts, and other materials necessary for institutional evaluation and audit compliance.
Knowledge of administrative and operational procedures related to budgets, purchasing, equipment inventory, contractual arrangements, and project resources.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with university staff, students, faculty, mentor teachers, field supervisors, district partners, and other stakeholders and to communicate and share information appropriately

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Education related fields required, Doctoral degree preferred.
Experience managing federal grants, particularly Title III, FUTURE Act, or Strengthening Institutions Programs.
Knowledge of Maryland State Department of Education (MSDE) licensure requirements.
Direct experience with educational technologies, including learning management systems (LMS), survey platforms, and educational tracking equipment.
Experience supporting teacher education programs, educator licensure preparation, standardized assessments such as Praxis II and edTPA, or K–12 clinical field placements.
Experience organizing professional development workshops, learning modules, training sessions, and student engagement activities.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Demonstrated leadership, organizational, communication, and project management skills.
Experience with project management, educational program coordination, data tracking, professional development coordination, and management of data systems is preferred.

Conditions Of Employment

Interested applicants, please apply online and include the following documents:

CV or resume
List of three(3) professional references
Unofficial Transcript leading degree conferral.

Additional Job Information

Benefits include medical, dental, prescription, long-term disability, accidental death and dismemberment insurance and life insurance; paid time for paid sick leave and annual leave; 10 paid holidays per year, tuition remission and supplemental retirement.

jobs.title: Principal Consultant Project Manager - Utility Return on Equity & Cost of Capital
jobs.description:
The Firm

Concentric Energy Advisors (“Concentric”) is an employee-owned
management consulting and financial advisory firm serving the North American energy and utility industries. Since 2002, Concentric has built a national reputation for excellence in ratemaking and utility regulation, litigation support, market strategy, and financial advisory services
, working with investor-owned utilities, regulators, and other industry participants on complex, high-stakes matters.

Headquartered in Marlborough, MA
, with offices in Washington, DC
and Calgary
, Concentric combines deep technical expertise with a collaborative, ownership-driven culture.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Principal Consultant Project Manager - Utility Return on Equity & Cost of Capital
- to manage complex utility consulting engagements. This role is designed for an experienced professional who has in-depth experience with Return on Equity or Cost of Capital analyses and is ready to take the next step in their career, managing both project engagements and employee teams.

This is a visible, client-facing leadership role, shaping regulatory strategy and managing project engagements.

*This is a hybrid role, with three days per week in-office in our Washington, DC location and two days per week working remotely.*

What You Will Do

As a Principal Consultant Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing most aspects of various client engagements – including communicating with clients on project scope project updates, working within budgets, delegating work to colleagues, and ensuring all deliverables are client-ready and free from any errors. Additional duties include:

Return on Equity & Cost-of-Capital Practice Area Management

Manage and review cost-of-capital and return on equity analyses for electric transmission and/or natural gas pipeline clients.
Advise clients on rate filings, compliance filings, settlements, and contested proceedings.

Written Testimony & Prudence Matters

Contribute to producing ROE and Cost of Capital documents including preparation and defense of written testimony, exhibits, workpapers, and discovery responses.
Support litigation strategy in close coordination with internal teams, external counsel, and client leadership.
Participate in hearings, settlement negotiations, and technical conferences.

Client & Practice Management

Manage multi-disciplinary consulting teams and complex engagements from scoping through final deliverables.
Act as a trusted advisor to utility executives on various topics.
Contribute to business development opportunities by leveraging professional relationships, regulatory credibility, and expert reputation.
Help shape and evolve Concentric’s ROE and Cost of Capital offerings, including mentoring junior staff and strengthening analytical standards.

What Success Looks Like

Successful candidates in this role are known for:

Clear, defensible analysis that stands up under cross-examination.
The judgment to balance technical rigor with regulatory strategy.
Comfort operating in high-stakes, adversarial settings.
The ability to translate complex concepts for senior decision-makers.
A reputation for integrity, credibility, and professionalism with regulators, clients, and peers.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Required Experience

10+ years of experience in ROE and Cost of Capital matters, gained through:
Consulting,
An investor-owned utility,
A regulatory agency (including former FERC or state commissions staff), and/or
A Big 4 or similar professional services firm.

Demonstrated experience managing ROE and Cost of Capital analyses for electric transmission and/or natural gas pipelines.
Strong written and oral communication skills, with experience presenting complex positions to regulators, attorneys, and senior executives.

Education

Bachelor’s degree required (Economics, Finance, Accounting, Mathematics, or similar preferred).
Master’s degree, MBA, or PhD strongly preferred.

Additional Expectations

Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively in team environments.
Strong attention to detail, organization, and professional judgment.
Willingness to travel for hearings, client meetings, and regulatory proceedings (U.S. and Canada).

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Description

Are you an organized and analytical professional who enjoys improving business processes, coordinating across teams, and helping others make effective use of business applications and data? Do you thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where accuracy, follow-through, and continuous improvement matter? If so, we’re looking for someone like you to join APL’s Finance Strategy & Operations team as a Business Operations Analyst in our Data Analytics Section.

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.

In this role, you will support business operations across the Business, Construction, and Facilities Department by helping coordinate the department’s use of Oracle E-Business Suite and related business applications. You will work with stakeholders to understand issues, document business needs, support system and process changes, coordinate testing and communications, and maintain clear procedures and reference materials. You will also develop expertise in Procurement and Accounting processes and data, perform analysis and reconciliation, and contribute to cross-functional initiatives that improve service, efficiency, data quality, and decision-making.

This position is well suited for a professional who enjoys learning complex business processes, organizing work across multiple stakeholders, and using data and business applications to solve operational problems. Over time, you will have opportunities to develop deeper expertise in enterprise applications, Procurement and Accounting data, business analysis, and process improvement.

As a Business Operations Analyst, You Will

Serve as the primary day-to-day business liaison for APL’s Oracle E-Business Suite enterprise resource planning application, assessing and triaging reported issues, directing them to the appropriate business or technical teams, and coordinating follow-up through resolution.
Gather, clarify, analyze, and document business, system, data, and reporting requirements for application enhancements, analytics efforts, and process-improvement initiatives.
Develop working expertise in Procurement and Accounting processes, data, business definitions, and relevant ERP data structures, helping stakeholders improve the consistency, traceability, and effective use of their data.
Analyze, validate, and reconcile ERP and operational data to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and support accurate reporting, reliable business processes, and informed decision-making.
Partner with Procurement, Contracts, Accounting, Finance, and IT to connect business processes, systems, and data and support cohesive solutions across the organization.
Develop and maintain process documentation, data definitions, user communications, and training resources to promote consistent system use and maintain effective operational coverage.
Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize, automate, or redesign recurring business and system processes, while also contributing to data requests, ad hoc analysis, special projects, and cross-functional initiatives

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you:

Possess a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Systems Engineering, or a related field, and have at least two years of relevant professional experience in business systems, business analysis, data analysis, finance, accounting, procurement, operations, or a related area.
Have experience supporting a complex business application or data-dependent business process, including assessing issues, coordinating resolution, documenting processes, or supporting system and process changes.
Demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to investigate discrepancies, evaluate information from multiple sources, and identify potential root causes.
Have experience gathering, clarifying, and documenting business, system, data, or reporting requirements and supporting related testing, implementation, or process-change activities.
Show proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, and have experience analyzing, validating, and reconciling data with a strong emphasis on accuracy and consistency.
Communicate clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, and are comfortable working with business users, technical teams, analysts, and organizational leadership.
Are detail oriented, well organized, and able to manage multiple priorities, maintain effective documentation, and follow issues and assignments through resolution.
Hold US Citizenship or permanent resident status, as required to access APL’s facilities and networks, subject to applicable laws

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you:

Experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite or another enterprise resource planning system from the business or functional side, particularly within Procurement, Accounting, Projects, Contracts, or related financial modules.
Experience performing business systems analysis activities such as triaging application issues, gathering requirements, coordinating enhancements, developing test scenarios, supporting user acceptance testing, or preparing user documentation and training.
Knowledge of Procurement, Accounting, financial management, or related business processes, including how business rules and transactions affect downstream data, reporting, and decision-making.
Experience using SQL and data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau to analyze, reconcile, validate, or present data.
Experience with data definitions, data lineage, data quality, data governance, process mapping, process improvement, or workflow automation.
Familiarity with internal controls, audit requirements, government contracting, or another regulated financial or operational environment.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. APL may offer bonuses or other forms of compensation per internal policy and/or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be provided in the form of a sign-on bonus, relocation benefits, locality allowance or discretionary payments for exceptional performance. APL provides eligible staff with a comprehensive benefits package including retirement plans, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, education assistance, and training and development. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis.

Description

Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.

Today, a lot of GCC's most valuable data is scattered. Research, media coverage, agency reporting, processes, and planning documents live in different places and formats, with different access. That makes it hard for teams to bring it together, and hard for AI to do anything with it. You'll connect those sources, structure them so AI can actually retrieve and reason over the content, and design tools on top of them. The teams who produce the data still own it. You make sure it's structured, accessible, and fits together, so everyone gets more out of it.

A lot of this job comes down to giving people across the team more ownership of their work. That happens two ways. First, by reducing dependencies, the places where people are stuck waiting on a manual step, a handoff, or the one person who knows how something works. Second, by clearing away the rote, repetitive work that fills their days. You'll get to know how GCC operates, find where both of these slow people down, and build what it takes to help. Everyone here is a builder, and your job is to support that.

No two months in this role look the same. The data keeps growing, the tools keep changing, and there's always a new challenge worth taking on. It's a great fit for someone who likes to work independently, dig into complex problems, and see their work make a difference across a team.

From helping get the boldest research ideas off the ground to supporting the most advanced equipment, together we are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in children’s health care. This is no small task—which is why we’re looking for passionate people to join our team and help propel our work forward to power the possible
.

What you’ll do

In this newly created Project Manager role, you will help strengthen our ability to successfully deliver important projects across the Foundation. Reporting to the Program Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape a growing project delivery practice while working on varied, organization-wide initiatives. You’ll partner with people across the Foundation, influence meaningful change and see how thoughtful project leadership helps our teams move our cause forward.

More specifically, you will:
Build clear project plans that define what needs to be achieved, who is involved and how the work will move forward.
Lead projects from start to finish, bringing together people from across the Foundation and keeping work moving toward agreed outcomes.
Keep people informed and aligned by facilitating conversations, supporting decisions and communicating progress throughout the project.
Navigate challenges as they arise, identifying risks and roadblocks early and working with the right people to resolve them.
Support successful implementation by tracking progress, helping teams adapt to change and capturing lessons that strengthen future projects.

What you’ll bring

We understand that no single candidate will perfectly meet all the qualifications outlined for this job posting. The following highlights the qualifications we consider important:

A bachelor’s degree in business administration, project management, information systems or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience, along with formal project management training; a PMP or CAPM designation is considered an asset.
At least five years of project management experience, with demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional projects from planning through implementation.
Strong project management knowledge and skills, with the ability to create clear plans, keep work moving and guide projects toward successful outcomes.
Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with an ability to build trust, bring different perspectives together and effectively guide teams without formal authority.
Sound judgement and problem-solving skills, including the ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities and complex challenges.
Experience with Asana is strongly preferred. Experience in a non-profit or complex stakeholder environment, and experience with technical, systems or process implementation projects are considered assets.

What you can expect

Ensuring that kids receive the best health care imaginable is no small task, therefore taking care of our team is a top priority. To help you power the possible and to support you in your health, well-being, and career growth, in additional to competitive compensation, we offer perks like a hybrid work environment (minimum of two days per week in office) and nine-day fortnight schedule, generous vacation, topnotch health and dental benefits, a health care spending account, a defined benefit pension plan, and a commitment to professional development.

The hiring range for this position is between $91,100 to $101,800.
At BCCHF, we are committed to ensuring that compensation is fair and equitable. Your placement in the salary range will be determined by your experience, relevant skills, and qualifications as they relate to this role.

Please note that all team members of BCCHF are required to complete vulnerable sector criminal record check as a condition of employment.

Join us

We exist to power the possible . And that permeates every action we take. As a team, we push ourselves to: think big in how we are boldly envisioning the future; step up in how we are accountable to ourselves, each other and our shared cause; and lead with heart in how we listen and engage with others.

BCCHF invites and encourages all qualified individuals to apply. As an organization committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and support. We welcome individuals whose lived experiences may further contribute to the rich diversification of skills, knowledge, and backgrounds at the Foundation.

If this feels like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you. Join us in helping make kids mighty.

Apply online at www.bcchf.ca/join-our-team/ by November 15, 2026.

jobs.title: Staff Program Manager, Connected Warfare (Active Clearance)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

The Connected Warfare division builds systems to support global command and control missions. We create joint, time sensitive, multi domain, ubiquitous, connected mesh ecosystems. Our ecosystem enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every robot, human, and sensor in every domain, bringing together hundreds of thousands of end points across the globe. We are the substrate that provides the source of truth for time sensitive decisions, effectively transforming the way that militaries close kills chains and enable mission autonomy.

About The Job

Own overall program execution - meeting cost, schedule, and performance targets and exceeding program and warfighter expectations.
Acquire an intimate understanding of program requirements and maintain open dialogue with the customer to ensure engineering efforts remain aligned to mission objectives.
Develop and implement effective processes, tools, and metrics for program planning, scope management, risk management, and overall program execution.
Foster a “Team of Teams” culture amongst Anduril, external customers, and industry partners to align objectives, optimize processes, gather insight, and drive on-time execution.
Build an outcome-oriented, high-performance culture within the program team that values development velocity, high-trust collaboration, rigorous execution, and continuous improvement.
Drive cross-functional alignment efforts to ensure seamless integration across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, test and evaluation, operations, business development, and other Anduril teams.
Autonomously execute on broad and/or ambiguous requirements from stakeholders. Demonstrate high ownership on all pieces of work. Become a trusted partner to Anduril’s engineers.
Support the drafting of technical proposals, ensuring that potential projects and scaling opportunities with each account are accurately scoped, resourced, and aligned with the organization's capabilities and strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

In partnership with the Chief Engineer, own overall program execution, meeting cost, schedule, and performance targets and exceeding program and warfighter expectations. Monitor and manage program resource allocation, making tradeoffs that enable us to deliver best-in-class solutions to our customers on-time and on-budget.
Acquire an intimate understanding of program requirements and maintain open dialogue with the customer to ensure engineering efforts remain aligned to mission objectives.
Develop and implement effective processes, tools, and metrics for program planning, scope management, risk management, and overall program execution.
Drive cross-functional alignment efforts to ensure seamless integration across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, test and evaluation, operations, business development, and other Anduril teams.
Develop strong, trusting relationships with Anduril’s DoD customers, ensuring we have tight feedback loops that enable us to shape solutions, rapidly iterate, and ultimately field solutions faster.
Autonomously execute on broad and/or ambiguous requirements from internal engineering, customers, and third-party partners to own successful delivery of outcomes on multiple programs simultaneously.
Develop and implement lightweight processes, tools, and metrics for program planning, scope management, risk management, and customer communication to enable Anduril to move rapidly.
Be high ownership on all pieces of work and become a trusted partner and advisor to Anduril’s engineers.
Foster a creative, high-performance culture within the team, and proactively assess team skills versus needs, identifying personnel development or recruitment opportunities to strengthen the team’s capabilities.

Qualifications And Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (technical background preferred)
Minimum of 8 years of proven program management experience in the defense, national security, or aerospace domains
Proven track record of successfully managing complex, multi-million-dollar projects and driving their on-time, on-budget completion
Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities with the ability to move seamlessly between tactical and the 30,000 ft level
Experience coordinating multiple internal and external teams within a complex engineering or technology-focused organization
Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences
Strong technical, analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, recommendations and drive decisions
Experience with tools like JIRA and Confluence
Current TS/SCI
Willingness to travel up to 50%

US Salary Range

$183,000—$229,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager - Defence and Security
jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

To find out more about our Property and Buildings business by clicking on the following link and discover what awaits you at WSP: https://www.wsp.com/en-GB/hubs/property-and-buildings

A Little More About Your Role…

We are looking for Assistant Delivery Leads, (Project Managers and Assistant Project Managers), to manage high-value, challenging projects and programmes within the Defence and Security sector. In this role, you will report to the Delivery Lead and be responsible for delivering projects according to the project plan. Assistant Project Managers will either support larger projects and programmes or take the lead on smaller projects as Project Managers depending on experience.

We are looking for proactive individuals who can build strong relationships with clients and internal teams to get tasks scoped and delivered to budget, on time and in line with client expectations and the WSP Business Management System. This is a hands-on role that will see you organising meetings, writing reports, controlling resources and monitoring finances.
You will be responsible for traditional project management activities including but not limited to scope and resource management, finance and schedule monitoring, change control, risk management and client management, overlaid with additional requirements of the Defence and Security sector such as security management.
As part of a growing and diverse team, you will be tackling complex building and infrastructure projects that span the RIBA design stages.

We are relatively new to the sector and are recruiting following several significant wins with both public and private sector clients. Overview

We are looking for an experienced, highly organized and proactive Web Development Project Manager
to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced digital environment, enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and knows how to keep multiple projects, people and deadlines moving at the same time. You will be responsible for coordinating projects across different teams, monitoring progress, identifying potential delays and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who does more than simply update tasks. You should be comfortable taking ownership of projects from start to finish
, following up with team members, solving problems and escalating risks before they become issues.

Please note:
We are looking for candidates with web development project management experience
— this is a priority for the role. Experience in a digital marketing agency
is also highly preferred.

What You Will Do

Manage multiple projects simultaneously from planning through to completion.
Develop clear project timelines, milestones, priorities and deliverables.
Coordinate work across different teams, including design, development, marketing, content and other operational functions.
Assign and monitor tasks and ensure team members understand their responsibilities and deadlines.
Conduct regular project follow-ups and ensure outstanding tasks continue moving forward.
Identify bottlenecks, dependencies and potential delays early and take action to resolve them.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within our project management systems.
Monitor deadlines and ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines.
Communicate project progress, risks, delays and required decisions clearly to management.
Run project meetings and ensure actions, owners and deadlines are clearly documented.
Follow up with team members on outstanding deliverables and hold stakeholders accountable for agreed deadlines.
Work closely with management to prioritize projects and allocate resources effectively.
Improve existing workflows, processes and project management systems.
Develop and maintain project documentation, SOPs and reporting where required.
Ensure completed work meets project requirements before projects are considered complete.

What We Require

Minimum 4 years of professional website development project management experience.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Strong experience working with cross-functional teams.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate project records.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong communication skills and confidence following up with team members and stakeholders.
Ability to identify problems early and propose practical solutions rather than simply escalating issues.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Technically fluent in dev workflows, including sprint planning, QA processes, and coordinating between design, development, and client teams.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Experience using project management platforms such as Monday.com, Asana, ClickUp, Jira or similar
.
Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Docs and Drive.

Highly Regarded

Experience working in a digital marketing agency, technology company or similar fast-paced digital environment
.
Experience managing website, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising, design or development projects.
Experience with Monday.com
.
Experience managing remote or internationally distributed teams.
Experience developing processes, workflows and SOPs.
Project management qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or Scrum certification
.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role if:
Projects are delivered on time and important deadlines are rarely missed.
Management has clear visibility over the status of every project.
Team members know exactly what they are responsible for and when it is due.
Delays and bottlenecks are identified before they become major problems.
Project information is accurate and consistently maintained.
You actively drive projects forward rather than waiting for others to provide updates.
Processes become more organized and efficient as a result of your involvement.

The Person We're Looking For

You don't need to be reminded to follow something up. If a deadline is approaching, you already know about it and are working with the relevant person to make sure it is delivered.
You are comfortable asking questions, challenging unrealistic timelines and holding people accountable while maintaining positive working relationships.
Most importantly, you have a strong ownership mentality
. When a project is assigned to you, you take responsibility for moving it forward and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Meaningful perks that reflect our commitment:

Competitive salary, inclusive of a monthly retention bonus.
Remote position (work from anywhere)
, full-time, and long-term
Annual compensation review
Fitness subsidy for 12 months to support your well-being.
Birthday leave, so you can celebrate and enjoy your special day off!
We observe local public holidays, allowing team members to rest and celebrate their national holidays.
15 days of Paid time off, ensuring team members have time to relax and recharge.
Global exposure and friendly work environment
Opportunity to learn new techniques & tools with a young and dynamic team
Lead performance with autonomy and visibility across departments.
Remote-first, collaborative culture that values initiative and outcomes.

Our Commitment

Mediboost is proudly an equal-opportunity employer.
We celebrate diversity, welcome individuality, and create a space where every voice is heard and valued.

new_jobs.description:
Summary

A Project Manager at MediaNews Group is responsible for the flow of work through product development and acts as a servant leader and coach for an agile team. You will lead the team via agile practices, ensuring that the agreed-upon process is followed. You will also remove impediments and foster high-performing team dynamics, continuous flow, and constant improvement. In a larger project management context, you will be responsible for balancing the competing needs of scope, schedule, and cost, while uncovering and monitoring risks. Finally, the Project Manager keeps stakeholders apprised of the status of a project or ongoing product development and is highly visible throughout the organization.

We are looking for a confident leader who thrives in dynamic environments, embraces change, and enjoys solving complex problems. You will be running a scrum team and playing the role of project manager on a larger program as needed. The ideal candidate isn't afraid of deadlines, can assert themselves when necessary, and isn't shy about addressing tough issues when they arise. Everyone on our team is a hands-on contributor, so be ready to roll up your sleeves and make an impact.

Although this is a remote role, candidates must reside in CO, FL, IL, MA, MN, OH, OK, PA, or TX.

What You Will Do

Apply agile and occasional waterfall methodologies and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices to initiatives from idea to launch and beyond, while ensuring alignment with SDLC standards and company strategy
Lead all aspects of the project, including planning, execution, timely delivery, functionality, quality, issue tracking, and communication
Maintain accountability for project delivery to the PMO, business owner, and stakeholders
Create initial project planning documentation, including assumptions/constraints, measures of success, quality measures, risks, mitigation plans, issues, dependencies, schedules, and change control strategy
Report progress, risks, and issues to management and project stakeholders; track risks, risk mitigation, known issues, change requests, and change impact in writing, and work to resolve blockers to completion
Use tracking tools to provide status and progress updates
Contribute to quarterly planning, Scrum of Scrums, all other agile ceremonies, and the project management community of practice
Lead by facilitation using standard scrum and scaled agile methodologies
Enforce the priorities of the work to be performed, as determined with the product owner, business owner, and project stakeholders; obtain product manager and client sign-off on key project deliverables
Conduct post-project reviews, lessons-learned discussions, and retrospectives
Draft and create project archives and process improvement plans based on lessons learned and retrospectives; implement approved plans
Add project documentation to the repository for use in future projects

What You Will Bring

Project management platform familiarity (Jira, Trello, Asana, etc.)
Web technology platform knowledge preferred
Experience in digital media strongly preferred
Agile project management training and at least 2 years of experience
Previous project management experience
PMP or CSM certification preferred

Benefits And Compensation

The salary range is $100,000 - $125,000. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to geographic location, education, work experience, time in role, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, the Company offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, life and disability insurance, 401k, as well as paid time off and select paid holidays (all benefits are based on eligibility). Please click the following link for more detailed information: www.mymedianewsgroup.com

Who We Are

MediaNews Group is a leading local news provider and digital marketing partner, with a 175+ year history dedicated to delivering impactful journalism and advertising that informs, inspires, and engages readers across diverse, local communities. With a portfolio of 77 daily and over 150 weekly publications nationwide, our products reach 47.2 million readers monthly with essential local news and information, including through brands such as: The Denver Post, San Jose's The Mercury News, Boston Herald, Saint Paul Pioneer Press, The Orange County Register, and more. The Product & Technology team's mission is to create people-centric digital technology that empower our local news and partners by putting people, product, and performance first. Our team builds product experiences across MediaNews Group's entire digital portfolio, including local news publications and the Adtaxi digital marketing agency. At MediaNews Group, you’ll join a team that values expertise, continuous learning, and autonomy, while embracing business agility through decentralized decision-making and scaled agile principles.

For over 45 years, CEQEL Critical Commissioning (CCCx) has been at the forefront of mission-critical commissioning services. Our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement has made us a trusted partner for complex facilities across various industries.

We combine decades of experience with cutting-edge technology to deliver reliable, efficient, and compliant commissioning services that meet the evolving needs of mission-critical environments.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:

Commissioning Program Manager

Position Location:

Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Travel Requirements:

Up to 75% travel for first 6 months then transition to 25%. Must have valid driver's license and ability to rent vehicles

Job Summary

The Commissioning Program Manager provides technical support and leadership to plan, schedule and execute full life cycle commissioning of hyperscale data centers / mission critical facilities on a programmatic basis. This person participates in the MEP design review process and participates in functional testing of complex electrical and mechanical systems, with a focus on higher level programmatic details.

The Commissioning Program Manager is responsible for supporting all aspects of the project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owners, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.

Position Summary

HIAS seeks a Associate Manager, Preferred Communities to support the resettlement and integration of refugees and other newcomers served through the HIAS network. The Associate Manager is responsible for the ongoing management and oversight of programs and services delivered by HIAS’ network of local resettlement affiliate partners, helping connect refugees to supportive institutions, essential services, and their new communities.

The Associate Manager oversees ORR Supplemental Funding provided through the Preferred Communities (PC) Program to ensure adequate resources are available to support particularly vulnerable refugee arrivals and strengthen the capacity of HIAS’ domestic affiliate network to support additional resettlement. The Associate Manager ensures compliance with current PC guidelines and high-quality programmatic reporting, oversees key aspects of PC budgets and program implementation, and provides ongoing training and technical assistance to affiliate partners to support high-quality service delivery.

Note, this position is based at our headquarters in Silver Spring, Maryland or our office in New York, New York, and we will consider a remote option for applicants who live outside of commuting distance to either of our offices and are based in other states in which we are registered (California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia).

The salary for this position is $75,000-90,000. This position is grant funded and the position is contingent on funding.

Essential Functions

Provides targeted technical assistance to HIAS affiliate partners and conducts assessments to identify service and resource gaps, strengthen program implementation, and support high-quality client services.
Oversees implementation of multiple PC program areas and funding streams, including cross-program coordination, workflow management, and alignment with ORR guidance.
Reviews budgets and approves invoices across PC funding streams, coordinates subaward processes with Grants Administration and Subaward teams.
Supports semi-annual and annual PC reporting to the federal funder, including compiling affiliate submissions, synthesizing network-wide narratives and data, and ensuring timely and compliant submissions through ORR systems.
Oversees PC data management and quality, including Apricot data oversight, dashboard reviews, RADS submissions, data consistency checks, outcome tracking, and other activities to assess progress toward program goals.
Conducts in-person and desk monitoring, prepares monitoring reports, and supports affiliate partners in addressing findings and strengthening program performance.
Develops and updates program standards, guidance, case management tools, training materials, and other resources to strengthen the quality and consistency of services across the affiliate network.
Contributes to evidence-based program design, continuous improvement, and innovation across Social Integration programs.
Serves as a liaison with government funders, national resettlement agencies, state government entities, technical assistance providers, and other partners within designated areas of responsibility.
Coordinates with affiliate partners to support continuity of client services during changes in service delivery, including office closures, new locations, and changes in service modality.
Supports the development and delivery of affiliate conferences, regional trainings, and other learning opportunities.
Provides support for other Social Integration program functions and priorities as needed, including during periods of increased workload or team transition.

Qualifications & Requirements

Undergraduate degree required; Master’s degree in Social Work or a related field is preferred.
5–7 years of relevant professional experience required.
Knowledge of and experience with the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program strongly preferred, including experience supporting refugees and immigrants through case management, community-based services, or other wraparound integration services.
Previous work experience at a national resettlement agency or local resettlement provider required.
Experience developing and delivering virtual and/or in-person trainings preferred.
Strong analytical skills, including experience using data to inform evidence-based decision-making; experience with statistical analysis preferred.
High proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint required.
Experience using and managing online databases and data collection systems preferred.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to develop policies, proposals, reports, and other professional documents and synthesize complex information and data.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Ability to travel within the U.S. as needed, approximately 3–6 times per year.
Must be authorized to work in the United States and able to provide employment eligibility documentation as required.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an Implementation Manager, independently motivated and ready to make our high-functioning Implementation Team even better. As an Implementation Manager, you will be our new customers’ primary contact, overseeing the onboarding process from end-to-end. This is a multi-faceted set of responsibilities including requirements gathering, configuration of our SaaS products to meet those requirements, carrying out basic project management activities, and ensuring a smooth transition from sales to adoption. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including sales, product management, customer success, and technical support, to deliver exceptional client experiences and drive customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do

Client Onboarding: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during the onboarding process. Conduct kickoff meetings, gather business processes and resulting requirements, and provide expert guidance on best practices for implementing and configuring our SaaS products to meet their unique needs.

Project Management: Carry out basic project management activities, notably that the work you are delivering falls within the scope of the implementation, that there are well planned & reliable communications, that you continuously evaluate points of risk and opportunity, and providing customer advice and assistance with their change management.

Product Configuration: Customize system settings, workflows, and integrations to align with client requirements while using out-of-the-box functionality to minimize customizations whenever possible. Depending on the product you may also:

Work extensively in Excel to prepare data and carry out initial data load;
Write simple scripts;
Author ad hoc reports on behalf of the customer.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, product management, customer success, and technical support teams to ensure a seamless transition from the sales cycle to adoption. Foster strong relationships with internal stakeholders, using effective communication to influence product design and customer life-cycle to deliver a coherent, high quality, client experience.

Training and Documentation: Engage the project team to develop and deliver comprehensive training sessions to educate clients on the features and functionalities of our SaaS products. Create and maintain implementation documentation, user guides, and knowledge base articles to support clients throughout the onboarding process ensuring the customer’s complete adoption of their product.

Issue Resolution: Identify and address implementation challenges, working closely with internal teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues promptly. Escalate complex problems to appropriate departments and provide timely updates to clients, ensuring their concerns are addressed effectively.

Continuous Improvement: Actively contributes to the enhancement of implementation processes and methodologies.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience in a client-facing implementation role, preferably in the SaaS industry.
Strong understanding of software implementation processes, methodologies, and best practices.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport, effectively collaborate with clients and internal teams, and be able to take the lead in a workshop environment.
Technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn and navigate new software applications, and the ability to identify and address implementation challenges effectively.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills – high comfort level with Excel is a plus.
Design and documentation of reports generated from relational databases – ability to author reports (SSRS or PowerBI) a significant plus.
Experience with CRM, ERP, or other enterprise software implementations, particularly GovTech, is a plus.
Familiarity with Jira, Cloud Coach, Autotask, Asana, or similar software for project tracking and time management is a plus.

This position will be Remote in the USA. Incumbent in this role is expected to work PT Hours.

We are looking for hands-on TPM’s with expertise and passion in solving difficult problems in all areas of software engineering: distributed systems, identity, security, observability, and user experience.

This is a greenfield opportunity to design and build new cloud centric applications from the ground up. We are growing fast, still at an early stage, and working on ambitious new initiatives. new_jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Ring Video Platform
new_jobs.description:
Description

The Ring Video Platform Team innovates in the video streaming space for Ring cameras. We are passionate about helping customers see what matters at home, whenever they need to. Every day, millions of Ring devices stream, record and process video through services we build and operate. At that scale we hold ourselves to a high bar for reliability, latency, video quality and privacy.

We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to set how our organization plans and delivers its most critical, multi-year initiatives across cloud services, device firmware and mobile apps. You'll partner with senior engineering leaders, programs will escalate to you, and you'll present complex decisions and trade-offs clearly to leaders up to the executive level. You won't be writing production code. You will be expected to read architectures, data and code, with AI help, well enough to tell when a plan, estimate or status is technically wrong, and to test technical trade-offs with evidence.

At Ring, TPMs operate with AI-native fluency: AI tools are a core part of how you plan, execute, communicate and deliver. As a Principal TPM, you'll set the AI-native standards for how programs are run across the organization, decide which tools get built, extended or retired, and define the bar AI-generated output must meet before anyone acts on it. AI fluency that doesn't improve customer outcomes is not enough. You own every output you ship, AI-assisted or not.

Key job responsibilities

Program Strategy: Set the program execution vision for Video Platform and own the multi-year strategy for its most critical cross-org initiatives, balancing new customer experiences with reliability, privacy, security and cost.
Portfolio Direction: Own portfolio-level decisions. Greenlight or stop work against clear success metrics, and build the case for what the organization takes on next, not only how it gets delivered.
Delivery at Scale: Deliver through others. Your success is measured by what the organization ships, not by the programs you personally run. Remove systemic blockers across teams and organizations, and build mechanisms that make delivery faster and more predictable without depending on you.
Technical Judgment: Test plans, estimates and status against the data. Identify risks and opportunities in architectures, technical strategies and team structures, and make the case for the changes that let teams deliver independently.
Stakeholder Communication: Write narratives and decision documents that directors and VPs act on. Represent difficult trade-offs clearly in business reviews and escalations.
TPM Community: Mentor TPMs and engineers, and raise the standard for how programs are run across Ring.
AI-Native Practice: Design program workflows with AI embedded from the start, including automated status, risk detection, dependency tracking and reusable tooling the organization adopts. When a tool or method falls short, fix the tool or the method, not just its output.

A day in the life

You're shaping several of the organization's highest-priority programs at once. In a typical week you might frame a multi-year delivery strategy with engineering leaders, deep dive into an architecture review to test whether a plan holds up, use AI-generated portfolio views to spot cross-team risks before they become escalations, decide with leadership which initiative to accelerate and which to stop, and improve the agentic workflows the team uses to run its programs. You balance hands-on judgment with long-range planning, and you keep automating the routine so that you and the organization can focus on decisions, strategy and customer impact.

About The Team

The Ring Video Platform organization, based in Cambridge/London, builds and operates the cloud services that power Ring video, from the moment a camera starts streaming to when a customer watches it on their phone. We're a collaborative group of teams with deep expertise in video streaming and distributed systems. We invest heavily in how we build, including how we use AI to do it, and we care about spreading that expertise across the organization.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in technical product or program management
Experience working directly with engineering teams
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience in architectural design or system design independent of an architect
Experience in technical program management
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Demonstrated fluency with AI tools in daily work (writing, analysis, reporting, research)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in hands-on work managing complex technology projects
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience designing AI-assisted or agentic workflows that automate program management work, such as status reporting, risk detection or dependency tracking, and that other teams adopt
Experience setting standards for how AI-generated output is validated before decisions are made on it
Experience delivering programs that span cloud services, device firmware and mobile apps
Experience with large-scale, real-time distributed systems, such as video streaming or media platforms

new_jobs.description:
At NVIDIA, we redefine what’s possible in digital imaging, personal computer gaming, and high-performance computing. Now, we lead the charge into AI’s unlimited potential. Lead cross-functional planning and execution for evaluation identification, selection and execution. With a focus on agentic-safety evaluations, including multi-turn tool calling, unsafe tool use, unintended actions, excessive autonomy, and multi-step failures.
Track execution, results for all evals, analysis, and the mitigation and research plans for improvement that will stem from results analysis. Translate evaluation findings into prioritized mitigation plans with accountable owners, committed dates, and measurable closure criteria
Lead end-to-end safety planning and execution for Nemotron models, including program scope, dependencies, risks, resources, and release-readiness criteria.
Translate technical safety priorities into executable programs covering LLM security, frontier risks, agentic safety, hallucinations
Establish and track multi-turn, multi-modal, multi-lingual, long-context, and reasoning model evaluations across relevant use cases, domains, languages, modalities, and model releases.
Establish governance for reviewing safety findings, assigning severity, determining release impact, and escalating unresolved risks. Ensure required safety evidence, approvals, exceptions, and risk-acceptance decisions are documented before release. Identify program gaps and critical dependencies early and drive decisions, escalations, recovery plans, and corrective actions.
Build (with AI for Code/AI for Work) and maintain dashboards and executive reporting for evaluation coverage, critical findings, mitigation progress, residual risk, and release readiness.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related technical field.
10+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, product development, technical operations, or a similar area.
Strong understanding of LLM architecture, frameworks (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face), and model evaluation.
Familiarity with LLM development, post-training, inference, tool calling, evaluation datasets, and model-release lifecycles.
Experience directing programs related to AI/ML development, model evaluation, agentic safety, security, content safety, hallucinations, and/or production releases.
Familiarity with AI safety risks such as hallucinations, timely injection attacks, unsafe tool use, data poisoning, model manipulation, and unintended agent behavior.
Experience supporting model-safety evaluations, Red Teaming, adversarial testing, security assessments, or responsible-AI programs.
Ability to interpret technical evaluation findings and communicate their product, schedule, and release implications to leadership.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience with LLM Agentic Safety, Security, Red Teaming, Hallucinations, adversarial assessment, or Responsible AI.
Experience defining evaluation datasets, rubrics, benchmarks, and release gates.
Ability to use evaluation results and data to make clear release recommendations and communicate residual risk to leadership.
Experience crafting or operationalizing multi-turn, hallucination, adversarial, or agentic-safety evaluations.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the pioneer and recognized leader in Cloud Computing. Our web services provide a platform for IT infrastructure in-the-cloud that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world. These customers range from start-ups to leading web companies to Global 500 companies. The Sales, Marketing, and Global Services Operations (SMGS Ops) mission is to enable the AWS field (“sellers”) organization to be the most efficient and effective in the world. Our goal is to reduce inefficiencies and overall cost of sales while identifying opportunities to accelerate revenue growth. Our team delivers the platform, data, mechanism, and insights that drive new sales strategies to accelerate revenue growth and enhance seller and leader workflows.

Key job responsibilities

As the right candidate, you will possess a strong program management background, have demonstrated experience leading large projects, and have a well-rounded technical background. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done. As a TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. Ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. High judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent and leadership experience will help to succeed in this role.

About The Team

IDEAS — Insights, Data Engineering, Econometrics, Analytics & Science — is the organization within AWS SMGS Ops responsible for turning data into insights for the AWS Sales and Marketing business. The team builds and operates the data infrastructure, analytics, and data science capabilities that help leaders across AWS understand their business, make better decisions, and serve customers more effectively at global scale.

We build with both native AWS technology — including state-of-the-art Generative AI — and industry-standard products, pairing the best of each to move faster, work smarter, and continually raise the bar on what our data and insights can do.

It is a collaborative, intellectually curious, and fast-moving group that partners closely with stakeholders across the company.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

Basic Qualifications

1+ years of technical product or program management experience
2+ years of software development experience
1+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

NVIDIA is defining the next era of computing, tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to power computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Our DRIVE platform gives automakers, Tier 1 suppliers, and start-ups the power and flexibility to develop and deploy breakthrough AI systems for autonomous vehicles — today powering over 270 partners in the development of autonomous cars, trucks, shuttles, and taxis.

We are looking for a deeply technical and experienced Senior Technical Program Manager to join the NVIDIA DRIVE AV Platform team. You will lead a focused effort to productize groundbreaking solutions that will redefine transportation and the growing field of self-driving cars. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with dedicated multi-functional engineering teams across vehicle subsystems — software, hardware, validation, and systems — to integrate their work into our autonomous DRIVE SW platform, while achieving or exceeding all relevant NVIDIA and automotive standards and guidelines. What sets this role apart: you bring real software engineering depth, specifically in embedded systems and platform software, driving engineering teams with credibility, attention to detail, and AI automation. The work is exciting, impactful, and fast-paced. We have customers and competition.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead multiple, concurrent complex programs across the autonomous driving platform — from embedded platform bring-up through production release.
Drive new platform technologies across the full stack: embedded OS, platform drivers, middleware, sensor integration, and validation.
Run automotive software development and releases in a highly dynamic environment, maintaining quality across rapid release cadences.
Translate deep embedded and SW knowledge into actionable program structures — defining scope, roadmaps, schedules, and milestones.
Identify and resolve risks and issues that affect release scope, schedule, and quality, especially those spanning SW/HW boundaries.
Identify and lead multi-functional dependencies proactively, including those spanning global engineering teams.
Improve processes and procedures within the team; streamline day-to-day operations with an eye for scalable engineering workflow using AI.
Communicate regularly with team members to set shared expectations and provide timely updates on progress, risks, and decisions.

What We Need To See

BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
12+ years of proven experience, with at least 8 years in Technical Program Management driving software engineering programs and releasing commercial products.
Solid understanding of embedded systems software: OS fundamentals (Linux, QNX, or similar RTOS), platform drivers, sensor middleware, and SW/HW integration.
Strong technical competence to engage deeply with engineering teams, debug program-level issues, and make sound trade-off calls across SW and HW domains.
Consistent track record of delivering scalable, complex programs in fast-paced, multi-functional environments.
Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills — you can translate deep technical complexity into streamlined executive updates and drive alignment across large organizations.

You have shipped embedded software in automotive, robotics, or a related domain to get software running reliably on constrained, safety-relevant hardware.
Direct experience in autonomous vehicle platform development, including ADAS software integration, sensor fusion stacks, or platform validation.

Background leading global programs across time zones with geographically distributed engineering teams.
