new_jobs.title: Security Technical Program Manager, Engineering Privacy & Access
new_jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Snap Engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of Snapchatters around the world, every day. We’re deeply committed to the well-being of everyone in our global community, which is why our values are at the root of everything we do. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.

We are seeking a Security Technical Program Manager (Security TPM) to help operate and scale the programs that protect Snap’s data, systems, identities, and customer experience.

This role serves as a portfolio-level program leader across Access and Privacy Engineering. You will turn ambiguous privacy and security priorities into clear operating models, roadmaps, controls, execution plans, and measurable outcomes. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Legal, Compliance, Security, and business teams to make the right work visible, actionable, and sustainable.

The role supports the full lifecycle of privacy and security risk: identifying signals, establishing ownership, defining requirements, prioritizing work, driving adoption, validating outcomes, and communicating decisions and residual risk to leadership

What you’ll do

Own the cross-functional privacy and data governance, translating strategy into priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans.
Build operating mechanisms for intake, prioritization, decision-making, escalation, dependency management, exceptions, and closure.
Drive privacy-by-design programs that define data use, retention, access, sharing, minimization, and control requirements early in the lifecycle.
Coordinate material reviews and clarify technical feasibility, required approvals, controls, decision rights, and ownership.
Lead complex, company-wide programs through rollout, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
Provide leadership visibility, resolve blockers, and automate program workflows where appropriate.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong understanding of privacy engineering, data governance, information security, and risk management.
Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs in privacy engineering, data governance, security, data, infrastructure, or platform environments.
Ability to connect technical and control requirements to business outcomes, customer experience, operational risk, and regulatory obligations.
Experience building operating models, governance mechanisms, roadmaps, metrics, decision frameworks, and leadership reporting in ambiguous domains.
Strong technical judgment, including the ability to evaluate trade-offs, clarify approval requirements, and distinguish facts, decisions, dependencies, and residual risk.
Track record of driving adoption of platforms, standards, controls, and processes across teams with varied incentives and maturity.
Excellent written and verbal communication, organization, prioritization, facilitation, and follow-through across long-running programs.
Collaborative leader who builds trust, resolves conflict, facilitates decisions, and mentors program managers.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
6+ years of experience in technical program management in the privacy engineering, compliance, risk management, or technical solution delivery domains
Demonstrated experience leading privacy engineering programs across multiple engineering or business organizations.
Demonstrated experience converting ambiguous requirements or risk signals into measurable execution plans and outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with privacy-by-design, data lifecycle governance, data classification, data inventories, data access, retention, deletion, or third-party data risk
Experience with GDPR, CCPA, NIST Privacy Framework, ISO 42001, NIST 2.0, ISO 27001, or comparable frameworks.
Experience building common-control frameworks, second-line monitoring, audit evidence, risk registers, or control-health reporting.
Experience operating in cloud-based environments such as Google Cloud or AWS.
Experience using automation, scripting, workflow tools, or data analysis to improve program execution.
Security, privacy, audit, risk, or cloud certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CIPM, CIPT, CIPP, or CCSP are a plus.

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

new_jobs.description:
Important Application Submission Information

In order to ensure your application is successfully received before the job posting expires, please submit your application by 11:59 PM on Wednesday, October 28, 2026

More than a career - a chance to make a difference in people's lives.

Build an exciting, rewarding career with us – help us make a difference for millions of people every day. Consider joining the Duke Energy team, where you'll find a friendly work environment, opportunities for growth and development, recognition for your work, and competitive pay and benefits.

Turbine and Generator Services (TGS) exists to provide programmatic engineering and technical support to the Regulated and Renewable Energy (RRE) fleet of turbines and generators. We embrace and diligently pursue the vision of zero major events for these centerline assets resulting in substantial and sustained improvements in station availability/reliability and exceptional long-term shareholder value. TGS is committed to relentlessly and purposefully leveraging people, organizations, information, technology, and analytical techniques to identify, evaluate and address any issue that could contribute to a major event.

This position will be responsible for managing Long Term Service Agreements with major Turbine/Generator OEMs.

This position is the expert level of the Generation Program Manager hierarchy and is responsible for the development and implementation of comprehensive programmatic strategies for the RRE fleet of turbines and generators. These strategies address corporate strategic objectives, financial goals, regulatory requirements, technology limitations, and OEM/vendor relationships. The Program Manager will ensure adequate and consistent plans, processes, documentation, and standards are developed, trained, implemented, and exercised to ensure all RRE sites maintain compliance with the program outline. At this level, the employee will solve the most complex problems and will have wide latitude for unreviewed work and proposals submitted to Senior Leadership teams. Assignments at this level require the highest level of critical thinking to resolve high-impact, complex and/or cross-functional problems. Incumbents are expected to have advanced skills, work independently and are to be considered industry experts in their discipline or in a particular field. They consult on strategic and highly complex work.

The incumbent must have leadership ability, organizational knowledge, experience, and strategic vision to implement relevant programs to address issues in the fleet. The incumbent must possess the technical acumen to design/analyze/assess program details, have proficiency in financial or economic analysis to optimize results and recommend adjustment to program initiatives, all to achieve defined improvement results.

The position requires excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead the preparation of complex reports and presentations. This level will frequently interface with all levels of management including GMs, VPs, Senior VPs, and the senior management groups.

The position requires a high level of coordination skills as well as the ability to manage complex technical projects involving other departments, outside consultants and industry groups. The Program Manager is expected to frequently interface with industry groups and peers to benchmark best practices and to lead the industry in a rapidly changing environment.

Responsibilities

Continually evaluate changing and emergent fleet events, industry developments, supplier changes, environmental legislation, regulatory drivers, and corporate strategic direction to identify opportunities to improve the performance and cost effectiveness of program strategies. Prepare reports, white papers, and/or presentations which address technically complex and financially significant issues
Leads the development and scoping of new improvement initiatives across the fleet to maintain compliance with standards and company governance and policies. Provides technical leadership for the execution of program initiatives. Effectively communicates the results of initiatives to senior management and other stakeholders. Build consensus through these efforts and secure project approval and funding when appropriate
Manage existing and develop new business relationships with OEMs and other vendors to ensure our business and other needs are being met (such as safety, quality work, good value, financial needs, warranty, etc.). Identify opportunities for multi-year vendor relationships to leverage cost savings and bundling opportunities. Assist with the resolution of contract performance commercial issues when stalled at the project level.
Develop and lead routine program assessment activities to provide early identification of gaps and program issues. Provide support for RRE stations during audits, assessments, and outage preparation and execution activities. Create tools and templates to perform gap analysis on important programmatic areas and prioritize recommendations that will lead to improvement action plans.
Influence business unit leaders on implementation of consistent standards across the business unit. Lead industry peer groups to ensure company engagement with emerging issues. Actively integrates industry best practices into Duke Energy fleet initiatives and programs. Establish metrics and KPIs in support of fleet initiatives and business targets. Revise initiatives to respond to changing industry/fleet trends and priorities

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a highly motivated Business Operations Program Manager to support the Senior Director of Data and Automation within OCI’s Supply Chain organization. This individual contributor role will help translate the leader’s data, automation, and operational-intelligence priorities into coordinated plans, clear operating rhythms, and measurable business outcomes.

The role will partner closely with data science, data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, and supply chain teams to support delivery of automation and decision-support capabilities across forecasting, supply planning, inventory, manufacturing, logistics, and deployment execution. Partner with the Senior Director of Data and Automation to coordinate strategic priorities, operating rhythms, business reviews, and cross-functional transformation initiatives.
Develop and maintain integrated program plans for data, analytics, AI, automation, and operational-intelligence initiatives, including milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
Support execution of initiatives that reduce manual work, improve process consistency, strengthen data visibility, and enable faster operational decision-making across Supply Chain.

Ongoing I Full Time | $138k - $154k +15.4% super | Salary sacrificing available

Lead people, science and capability to deliver strategic outcomes in bulk material analysis and nuclear security science.

About the Opportunity

The Science Program Manager, Bulk Material Analysis is responsible for providing leadership in management of staff and delivering a science program, within the Nuclear Security Science capability area, focused on nuclear forensic material analysis to support law enforcement and nuclear security. The position also contributes as a project team member, leading research outcomes for the team.

The position of Science Program Manager, Bulk Material Analysis provides operational management of activities to produce outcomes and achievement of the capability area’s objectives, in alignment with the strategic directions of ANSTO and Nuclear Stewardship. 

It is highly desirable that the successful candidate already holds a national security clearance.

About You

"We are looking for a leader who combines expertise in bulk material analysis and nuclear security science with the ability to inspire high-performing teams, deliver complex scientific programs, and build strong collaborative partnerships across government, industry and research organisations. The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable guiding strategy and people as they are contributing scientific expertise to solve challenging real-world problems." - Dale Codling, Manager Nuclear Security Science

Your Duties and Responsibilities

Contribute to the development and implementation of the capability area objectives through implementation of the designated capability area’s plans, goals and activities to deliver outcomes to achieve Nuclear Stewardship’s strategic objectives and Nuclear Security Science’s operational plan.
Provide oversight of projects within the Bulk Materials Analysis science program by reviewing and reporting on project plans, allocating resources, tracking, reporting of budgets and expenditure and providing reports to line management.
Develop and maintain collaborative networks across internal and external stakeholders to support and advance the delivery of the science program.
Deliver a project management approach to the management of the science programs and provide oversight of science integrity, quality and compliance.
Support initiatives and strategies to increase capability area investment through identified partnerships and with external and internal stakeholders.
Contribute scientific knowledge and expertise to projects as a project team member. Engage in scientific activity ranging from fundamental research to the investigation of specific industry or partnered operational problems and pursue new ideas and approaches that create new concepts.

Please view the full Position Description for further details or click Apply to view.

ANSTO is a leading global nuclear science and technology organisation delivering world-class research and expertise to benefit Australia and support a more sustainable future. Using nuclear science, we improve health, support industries, provide expert advice to government on nuclear technologies and help develop Australia’s nuclear workforce.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
About The Job You’re Considering

As a Senior Project/Programme Manager, you will lead the delivery of large, complex IT and technology projects and programmes for our public sector and other clients. You will be responsible for managing high-visibility deliveries across the full project lifecycle, from initiation to end-to-end delivery, ensuring successful outcomes in dynamic, multi-supplier and matrix environments.

You will provide strong leadership to multi-discipline and multi-supplier teams, foster a collaborative and high-performing culture, and engage with senior stakeholders to deliver value and drive continuous improvement.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

To be eligible for employment you must have the unrestricted right to work in the UK and be eligible for SC clearance (see more below). We do not offer sponsorship.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:

identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

Lead the delivery of large and complex IT/technology projects and programmes across the full project lifecycle (end-to-end), ensuring delivery to agreed scope, quality, time, and budget.
Provide strong leadership to multi-discipline and multi-supplier teams, motivating and guiding them to achieve high performance in matrix environments.
Develop and maintain project/programme schedules, establish delivery rhythms, manage risks and dependencies, and proactively remove blockers.
Build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders at all levels, including senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment and successful delivery.
Drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency through agile delivery practices and lessons learned.
Manage projects/programmes in line with budget(s), ensuring accurate forecasting, value delivery, and effective change control.
Demonstrate commercial acumen, including developing commercial proposals and working with various contract types (e.g., Time & Materials, fixed price).
Provide clear reporting and data to support communication with senior stakeholders and support decision-making.
Ensure deliverables meet quality standards appropriate to their stage and are completed on time.
Foster a productive, inclusive, and collaborative working environment that supports professional growth and innovation.

Your Skills And Experience

Proven experience delivering IT/technology projects and programmes at a senior level, ideally within large and complex environments, from end-to-end.
Demonstrated ability to manage large and complex projects/programmes across the full project lifecycle and end-to-end delivery.
Strong understanding of agile delivery practices, project/programme lifecycle management, and experience working in matrix and multi-supplier team environments.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience engaging with senior stakeholders.
Demonstrated leadership in motivating and guiding multi-discipline and multi-supplier teams to achieve high performance.
Experience managing projects/programmes in line with budget(s), ensuring accurate forecasting, value delivery, effective change control and active RAID ownership
Demonstrate financial acumen, including P&L accountability and budget management.
Proven ability to identify, assess, and proactively manage project and programme risks, implementing effective mitigation strategies and ensuring timely resolution of issues.
Exceptional planning skills, with a proven ability to develop robust project and programme plans that align with organisational objectives and ensure successful delivery.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini Is Proud To Be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) Under The UK Government’s Disability Confident Scheme. As Part Of Our Commitment To Inclusive Recruitment, We Will Offer An Interview To All Candidates Who

Declare they have a disability, and
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

new_jobs.description:
Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar - delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy.

Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact - both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best.

Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs.

Position Summary

Standard Operations Position. Provide end-to-end project management, leadership and coordination for large complex projects or as a part of a transformational project work stream with responsibility for project scope, schedule, cost and risk management. Ensure alignment of financial and operational goals between projects and the business unit. Provide work team direction to achieve approved project scope, develop strategic sequencing and detailed milestone schedules, project-level cost tracking and reconciliation. Ensure availability or seek out adequate resources for projects.

Essential Responsibilities

Financial Management: Function as project controller. Manage project financials including budgeting, forecasting, and actuals tracking. Facilitate RFP and contract management processes. Review actuals versus planned budget throughout project life cycle to identify variances and recommend corrective action. Ensure timely project closure, payment and reconciliation.
Project Planning: Lead requirements gathering and planning process for approved projects while engaging all key stakeholders. Develop solution design that defines the entire project scope, and secure all required internal/external approvals. Ensure coordination with other initiatives, assuring dependencies are identified and addressed. Define deliverables and required delivery dates; develop viable work plans/WBS, milestone schedules, and project cost/benefit estimates.
Project Management: Independently manage detailed project plans to approved scope and provide cross-functional tracking as needed. Identify plan gaps and develop closure plans. Ensure the successful completion of assigned project deliverables & milestones in a dynamic/complex environment.
Resource Management: Manage resources, both internal and external. Manage assigned contracts and associated payments and performance requirements. Develop and adapt a comprehensive resource plan for a matrixed team of diverse talent to maximize skills and minimize cost. Provide mentoring and guidance to less experienced project team members.
Scope & Risk Management: Manage scope change request process for project. Identify risks and issues throughout the project lifecycle and create mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
Relationship Management: Communicate project status to all levels of the organization. Establish effective, collaborative working relationships to maximize project efficiency, responsiveness and resource allocation.

Minimum Requirements

8 years work experience in operations, technology, finance, or comparable function.
Utility experience preferred.
BS Engineering, Construction, Business, Information Technology or related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
5 - 7 years' experience in project management and process improvement.
Some formal project management training preferred.
Demonstrated ability to lead and influence others, informal leadership experience and training skills preferred.
Strong presentation and facilitation skills; excellent written/verbal communications skills required.
Understanding of core business processes/ industry trends with ability to interpret/apply ongoing changes.
Knowledge of project planning and business need justification process and methodology.
Ability to adapt to change quickly and work within a diverse, cross-functional team environment.
Vendor/contract management experience preferred.

Preferred Requirements

Audit experience involving assurance and validation of adherence to security or regulatory standards.
NERC CIP experience.
Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) or TSA experience.

Our culture is grounded in shared values and employee commitments that guide how we work, support one another, and grow together.

Our Values

Connected, Committed, Trustworthy, Safe

Our Employee Commitments

Work that makes a difference
A team you can count of
Opportunities to grow
Rewards that help you thrive

Xcel Energy provides job applicants reasonable accommodations for disabilities throughout the application process. If you are in need of an accommodation to complete the application process, now or at any time in the future, please complete the Applicant Accommodation Request Form.

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Role Overview

As a GTM Enablement Manager on our Customer Education team, you will design and deliver training that helps Deel customers get real value from our platform. You will run live, instructor-led workshops, build custom sessions and programs for customers with specific needs, and support our certification and self-serve learning offerings. You will work directly with customers and internal teams to turn product knowledge into skills customers can use right away. This role includes some travel to deliver on-site customer training.

Key Responsibilities

Live Instructor-Led Training: Plan and facilitate engaging live workshops, webinars, and virtual or in-person sessions for customers at all levels, from onboarding to advanced product use. Travel to customer sites and regional events as needed to deliver training.
Custom Training Programs: Partner with Customer Success and Account Management to assess customer needs and build tailored sessions and multi-part programs for strategic accounts, new product rollouts, and specific customer roles or use cases.
Training Content Development: Create facilitator guides, slide decks, hands-on exercises, demos, and job aids that make sessions practical, interactive, and easy to repeat and scale.
Scalable Learning Assets: Turn high-performing live content into self-paced courses, recorded sessions, and learning paths so more customers can learn on their own schedule.
Certification Support: Help build and maintain customer certification tracks and exams that validate skills and recognize customer expertise.
Customer Engagement and Promotion: Drive registration and attendance for training and certification offerings through targeted outreach, campaigns, and partnership with Customer Success and Marketing.
Cross-Department Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Customer Success, Support, and Marketing to keep training accurate and aligned with product releases, and to gather customer feedback that improves content.
Metrics and Reporting: Track attendance, completion, satisfaction (CSAT), certification rates, and impact on adoption and customer outcomes, and use the results to improve sessions and programs.
Content Updates: Keep training materials current with product changes, customer feedback, and best practices.

3+ years of experience in customer education, customer training, enablement, or a similar role.
Proven experience facilitating live, instructor-led training (virtual and/or in person) for external audiences.
Experience designing custom training sessions or programs based on audience needs and business goals.
Working knowledge of instructional design and adult learning principles, including creating self-paced content.
Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and adapt to different audiences and skill levels.
Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS), webinar and virtual training tools, or certification platforms.
Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and customer feedback to improve training.
Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines, including coordinating with stakeholders.

Self-starter who works independently, takes initiative, and raises risks early.
Results-driven, with a track record of getting things done in a dynamic environment.
Experience in a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.

Experience with HR, payroll, or global workforce software.
Experience training customers across regions or time zones.

Occasional domestic and/or international travel to customer sites, with some flexibility in hours when delivering sessions across time zones.

A Little Bit About Us

Nestlé Nespresso SA is a pioneer and is widely regarded as one of the top references in the field of high-quality portioned coffee. The company works with more than 130 000 farmers in 18 countries through the Nespresso Sustainable Quality Plan to embed sustainability practices on farms and the surrounding landscapes. Launched in 2003 in collaboration with the NGO Rainforest Alliance, the Nespresso Plan helps to improve the yield and quality of harvests, ensuring a sustainable supply of high-quality coffee and improving livelihoods of farmers and their communities.

In 2022, Nespresso achieved B Corp™ certification – joining an international movement of over 10’000 purpose-led businesses that meet B Corp’s high standards of social and environmental responsibility and transparency.

Headquartered in Vevey, Switzerland, Nespresso operates in 98 markets and has over 14'000 employees. In 2025, it operated a global retail network of 849 boutiques. For more information, visit the Nespresso website: www.nespresso.com.

Position Summary:

We’re looking for a curious, strategic Consumer & Market Insights Manager
to join our Insights & Analytics team at Nespresso Canada and turn consumer understanding into opportunities that shape our future.

As Consumer & Market Insights Manager
, you will report to the Insights & Analytics Manager, and you’ll shape and lead the integrated insights agenda for Nespresso Canada, transforming complex consumer, market, customer, and competitive data into clear strategic recommendations. As a trusted partner to senior leaders and cross-functional teams, you will help guide business planning, innovation, portfolio, media, channel, acquisition, and profitability decisions while building alignment around key growth priorities.

Consumer & Market Insights Manager
:

Deep understanding of Canadian consumers, customers, regions and channels; experience in coffee, consumer goods, retail, e-commerce or B2B environments is valued.

A strategic and curious mindset, sound judgment, intellectual rigor, integrity and comfort operating in ambiguity.

Bilingualism in English and French language skills are a requirement, as this position requires collaboration with stakeholders across the Canadian market and/or worldwide

new_jobs.title: Senior Risk Intelligence Manager, GRAMI Risk Intelligence
new_jobs.description:
Description

Are you energized by the challenge of identifying, assessing, and mitigating complex risks at scale? Amazon is looking for a Risk Manager III to own and drive cross-functional risk programs that protect our customers and business. In this role, you will manage the full lifecycle of risk programs, partnering with legal, engineering, and business teams to design and implement controls, interpret regulatory requirements, and quantify risk reduction through data-driven metrics. You will balance competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and translate complex risk landscapes into clear strategies and actionable plans that leadership can rally behind.

Key job responsibilities

Own the development of data-driven risk intelligence initiatives end to end across multiple global risk domains in supply chain.
Partner with Product and Tech to develop Machine Learning models that detect and prioritize risk.
Identify priority risk areas and scope high-impact use cases, including in ambiguous spaces where no precedent exists.
Conduct data analysis and research to develop risk indicators that feed the models and shift detection from reactive and periodic to proactive and risk-based.
Deep-dive on available data sources, determine authoritative sources of truth across multiple systems, and trace data lineage and ownership.
Provide the risk and compliance judgment that models require, evaluating the reasoning behind model outputs, and validating that models identify genuine risk.
Assess the downstream impact of model-driven decisions, and how model outputs translate into risk-based action.
Work with operations teams to incorporate the Machine Learning solutions into operation workflow, transforming risk management from a reactive, periodic posture to a proactive, risk-based one.
Drive ongoing alignment of solutions with partners and stakeholders across Product, Tech, Operations, Finance, and Legal without direct authority.
Communicate risk intellgence insights and program progress to leadership and stakeholders at all levels.

A day in the life

You will start your day reviewing risk metrics and control performance data, then shift into cross-functional meetings where you align stakeholders on program priorities and resolve open issues. You might spend the afternoon drafting a narrative for senior leadership that frames a newly identified risk alongside recommended mitigations, or evaluating whether a proposed control meets regulatory requirements. Expect to leverage generative AI tools to accelerate research and analysis while applying your judgment to refine outputs and ensure accuracy.

About The Team

Our team is dedicated to building and scaling risk management programs that keep Amazon's customers and operations protected. We work at the intersection of business strategy, regulatory compliance, and technology — partnering across the company to create practical, measurable solutions to complex risk challenges. We value collaboration, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to tackle ambiguous problems. If you are motivated by meaningful impact and want to help shape how Amazon manages risk at a global scale, we would love to hear from you.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in compliance, audit or risk management
6+ years of data-driven business/risk intelligence related experience
Bachelor's degree, or Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree or equivalent
Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion
Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. HII Mission Technologies has been selected as one of Military.com's "Top 25 Employers for Veterans in 2024" and we are a Forbes Best Large Employer for 2023!!!

HII: Mission Technologies
is seeking a qualified Sr Industrial Security Analyst
(ISA 3) to support the Mission Technologies Home Office located in Virgina. The selected candidate will be dedicated primarily to Investigations support, with secondary responsibilities in Physical Security, improving operational responsiveness—particularly across the high‑volume Tidewater region.

Details below!

The ISA 3 will provide robust support to the Investigative function
, addressing current operational constraints and ensuring continuity of effort. Key responsibilities include:

Maintain a regional inventory of physical security equipment and spare parts.
Manage safe storage and logistical movement of materials through the Suffolk warehouse.
Provide on‑site troubleshooting support in coordination for system issues occurring across regional locations.

Offer rapid‑response on‑site troubleshooting to reduce service‑call costs and accelerate issue resolution

Experience providing physical on-site security, preferably on a US Government site or military installation either directly or through a contractor

Job performance requires adequate visual acuity and manual dexterity for meeting the requirements of the discipline. Office work environment.
Travel to local sites within the Tidewater areas

Resource Management: Manage resources, both internal and external. Manage assigned contracts and associated payments and performance requirements. Scope & Risk Management: Manage scope change request process for project. Identify risks and issues throughout the project lifecycle and create mitigation strategies and contingency plans.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

You will gain first-hand experience in enterprise data modeling and analysis. You’ll build data products and solutions such as dashboards, self-service tooling, and data pipelines for consumers across Planet, leveraging tools including git, dbt, python, SQL and Omni. Experience with git or other version control

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Analytics - Austin TX (Hybrid)
new_jobs.description:
Luxury Presence
is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Why This Role Matters

Our GTM Analytics team owns the metrics that run the business for Sales, Marketing, and Client Success. We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting — we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools.

This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster.

You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used — fast.

What You'll Do

GTM Analysis & Decision Support

Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers.
Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision — not just a dashboard handoff.
Bring structure to ambiguous asks — translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach.

Data Modeling & Quality

Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system.
Own data quality and documentation for your domain: clear definitions, source-of-truth tables, and QA that stakeholders can trust without double-checking.

Lighthouse & Agentic Analytics

Contribute to Lighthouse, our BI-as-code platform, as we build it out — help define how dashboards, metrics, and semantic models get written, versioned, and reviewed like software.
Note: Lighthouse is an active build, not a finished platform — you'll be shaping it, not just using it.
Push our analytics workflows toward agentic AI: using AI agents to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting, and cut down on manual, one-off dashboard requests.
Bring a point of view on where AI can replace manual analyst work versus where it can't — you should be as comfortable prompting and evaluating an agent as writing the SQL yourself.

How You'll Work

Operate in two-week sprints, planning and prioritizing your own backlog against team OKRs alongside your manager.
Give clear, proactive status updates to stakeholders rather than waiting to be asked.

Experience

What We're Looking For

5+ years in analytics/BI, with meaningful time supporting Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success functions at a fast-growing company. Staff-level candidates should bring deeper scope — larger or more ambiguous problems owned end-to-end, and a track record of setting technical direction, not just executing against it.
Expert SQL and hands-on dbt experience modeling GTM data.
Comfortable with Python for analysis and automation — this isn't a heavy ML/stats role, but you know how to script your way out of manual work.
Experience with Salesforce as a data source — you understand CRM objects, fields, and the quirks of modeling data.
Familiarity with a modern data stack: Fivetran or similar EL tooling, and a cloud warehouse (we run Snowflake; BigQuery experience also welcome).

BI & AI Fluency

Experience with at least one modern BI tool (Sigma, Hex, Tableau, Looker, or similar) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement — what matters more is that you understand how modern BI organizations operate: governed semantic layers, self-serve dashboards, and BI-as-code approaches.
Genuine curiosity about agentic analytics — you've used AI agents or LLM tools to speed up analysis, and you want to help define what that looks like at scale.
We build with Claude day-to-day, so hands-on experience with Claude Code (or a similar coding agent like Codex) is a big plus — you'll use it to move faster on dbt models, scripting, and analysis, not just as a novelty.

Mindset

Strong communicator who can frame a recommendation clearly for a non-technical stakeholder and defend it under questioning.
Comfortable with the accountability of owning a deliverable through to closure, not just the analysis in the middle.
Energized by ambiguity and fast iteration — two-week sprints mean you'll ship early and often.

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Affordable energy for everyone.

This position is expected to report to the Portland office quarterly at a minimum for all staff and other in-person meetings.

Conduct descriptive and statistical data analyses and market research for evaluation and market research projects.
Acquire, develop, manage, integrate, analyze, and visualize third-party and internal datasets to support organizational data and information needs.
Work with Planning and Evaluation, Operations Analyst, and IT staff to build out the functionality of data systems and make them accessible and useful for staff.
Serve as owner of key data with the responsibility of standardizing definitions, documentation, content, quality, security, and value throughout the organization.

new_jobs.description:
The Institute for Community and Rural Health at West Virginia University is currently accepting applications for a (Hybrid) Data Analyst.

About The Opportunity

The Data Analyst supports data management, research, program evaluation, and grant reporting across the Institute for Community and Rural Health. Working with faculty, program managers, and community partners, this position manages data from collection through analysis, reporting, and archiving. The analyst ensures that project data are accurate, secure, well documented, and usable for program improvement, research, and funding proposals. Projects may include rural health, Food is Medicine, healthcare access, workforce development, and local food systems.

Benefits

We strongly believe in work-life balance and keeping time for things we love outside our work. WVU offers generous benefits, including:

37.5-hour work week
13 paid holidays (staff holiday calendar)
24 annual leave (vacation) days per year (employee leave)
18 sick days per year (for when you’re ill, for when you need time to care for sick family, for your own, or your family’s, regularly scheduled medical appointments. Who is family for the purpose of this leave? A lot of people in your life including immediate relatives and in-laws as well as others considered to be members of your household living under the same roof)
WVU offers a range of health insurance and other benefits
401(a) retirement savings with 6% employee contribution match, eligibility to continue health insurance, and other retiree perks. Looking for more retirement benefits information? Check out retirement health insurance benefits, retirement income, and FAQ’s.
Wellness programs

What You'll Do

Data Management and Quality
Develop and maintain project data management plans covering collection, storage, access, quality assurance, sharing, retention, and archiving.
Build and maintain databases, electronic data collection forms, data dictionaries, codebooks, and standard operating procedures.
Establish consistent variable definitions, naming conventions, participant and site identifiers, and file organization across projects.
Coordinate data submissions from project teams and partners, including submission schedules, required formats, secure transfers, and correction of incomplete records.
Integrate and reconcile data from surveys, program records, clinical partners, and public datasets while documenting sources and transformations.
Conduct routine quality checks for missing values, duplicate records, inconsistencies, and outliers; maintain records of issues and their resolution.
Prepare and maintain analysis-ready datasets, tracking versions and preserving source data and reproducible processing steps.
Coordinate with authorized university teams to implement appropriate access permissions, secure storage, backups, and recovery procedures.
Prepare de-identified datasets and support authorized data sharing consistent with approved protocols and data-use agreements.
Maintain documentation needed for monitoring, audits, staff transitions, and project closeout.

Analysis, Evaluation, and Reporting
Conduct descriptive statistics, trend analyses, and comparisons of program participation, service delivery, costs, reach, and outcomes.
Support study design, measure selection, and statistical analyses in collaboration with faculty investigators and evaluation leads.
Create dashboards, visualizations, tables, and concise reports for faculty, program managers, funders, and community partners.
Track performance measures and prepare accurate, timely data summaries for grant reporting and project reviews.
Interpret findings with project teams, clearly explaining limitations and implications for program improvement.
Contribute analytical methods, tables, and findings to manuscripts, presentations, and funding proposals.

Collaboration and Training
Work with faculty and program managers to establish data requirements, responsibilities, and reporting timelines.
Train staff, students, and partners on data collection tools, entry procedures, quality standards, and secure handling.
Follow applicable university requirements, approved research protocols, data-use agreements, and privacy and security procedures.

Bachelor’s degree in statistics, data analytics, public health, epidemiology, economics, computer science, or a related field.
A minimum of one (1) year of experience in the following:
Experience collecting, managing, cleaning, analyzing, and reporting quantitative data.
Experience developing or maintaining databases, data documentation, and quality assurance procedures.

Any equivalent combination of related education and/or experience will be considered.
All qualifications must be met by the time of employment.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Proficiency in Excel and at least one analytical programming or statistical software package, such as R, Python, SAS, or Stata.
Understanding of descriptive statistics, data visualization, and secure data handling.
Ability to explain findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage deadlines across multiple projects.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in a relevant field.
Experience with public health research, program evaluation, rural health, or grant-funded initiatives.
Experience with SQL, REDCap, Power BI, Tableau, or GIS.
Familiarity with relational databases, automated data processing, and version control.
Experience managing longitudinal or multisite datasets and working with sensitive health or participant information.
Experience supporting research manuscripts, funding proposals, or funder reports.

About WVU

West Virginia University is a place of purpose and community. We take pride in our profound impact on the state of West Virginia and are committed to the personal and professional growth of our employees.

From the groundbreaking R1 research at our flagship campus in Morgantown to the career-oriented programs at WVU Potomac State in Keyser, and the technology-intensive programs at WVU Tech in Beckley, the contributions of WVU employees resonate across the state, touching lives and shaping futures.

At WVU, you will discover a supportive community that champions work-life balance and fosters a collaborative atmosphere. Our core values — service, curiosity, respect, accountability and appreciation — unite us as Mountaineers.

Join us at West Virginia University, where your work will make a lasting impact. To learn more about WVU, visit wvu.edu.

new_jobs.description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

About The Role

The People Ops & Tech organization builds and runs the technology and service engine behind the employee experience at Blue Origin. Our software and agile teams carry 50+ enhancement projects at any given time in addition to multi-month and multi-year projects. Our HR Service Center resolves more than 60,000 employee service requests every year. We are also moving our services, and our tools toward AI. Running that complexity well take an operator with real depth.

This role will act as a strategic partner to the leader of the People Ops & Tech organization and will be a core member of that leadership team. You will own the business operations program, including the status reporting, rhythm of business, risk and issue management, and escalation mechanisms that keep a complex organization running cleanly. You will also modernize how work is managed across every team, so leadership has a single, trustworthy view of what is happening, when it is at risk, and what comes next. You will put in place the audit and quality mechanisms and escalation triggers that catch data and product issues before our customers do.

This is a strategic, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in the details of a portfolio plan as they are in an executive review. You are AI-literate and know how to use AI to run a faster, more proactive, more transparent operation.

Responsibilities

Run the business operations engine. Own the organization's operating rhythm: weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, leadership team cadences, planning cycles, and executive reporting. Make sure the right information reaches the right people at the right time, with minimal manual effort.
Own status, risk, and issue management. Establish and run consistent mechanisms for status reporting, risk and issue tracking, dependency management, and escalation across all teams. Move the organization from reacting to problems to anticipating them, with clear early-warning signals and defined escalation paths.
Modernize work and portfolio management across the HR Tech and service delivery portfolio. Assess current work management practices across software, agile, service operations, and the HR Service Center. Design and implement a unified approach to intake, prioritization, capacity planning, demand management, and delivery tracking that covers 50+ concurrent enhancement projects and ongoing service work. Standardize tooling, taxonomy, and practices while respecting the different needs of each team.
Create a single source of truth. Build integrated dashboards and reporting that give leadership real-time, accurate visibility into portfolio health, delivery performance, service metrics, and operational risk. Automate data collection and reporting wherever possible.
Build audit and quality mechanisms. Partner with product, data, and service teams to design controls that detect data inaccuracies, system breaks, process failures, and service defects before employees experience them. Define monitoring, reconciliation, and audit routines. Drive root cause analysis and corrective action, and track whether fixes hold.
Apply AI to operations. Identify and implement AI-enabled approaches to work management, reporting, risk detection, and service operations. Partner with technology and data teams to evaluate tools, run pilots, and scale what works. Help the organization adopt new ways of working as services and tools shift toward AI.
Drive operational performance. Define, track, and report metrics for delivery, service quality, productivity, and customer experience (such as on-time delivery, request volume and resolution time, backlog health, defect rates, and audit findings). Turn insights into prioritized improvements.
Partner across the leadership team. Support strategic planning, budget and resource tracking, org-level goals and OKRs, and cross-team initiatives. Facilitate alignment and drive follow-through on leadership decisions. Act as a trusted advisor to the HR Technology & Operations leader.
Influence without authority. Lead through credibility, clarity, and relationships across teams, HR Centers of Excellence, and technology partners. Coach team leaders on operating mechanisms and best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in related field, or equivalent experience
8+ years of progressive experience in business operations, program or portfolio management, technology operations, or a related field, including experience supporting a senior leadership team
Experience designing and running operating rhythms, status reporting, and risk, issue, and escalation management in a large, complex organization
Experience in portfolio and work management practices across agile and non-agile delivery models
Experience managing or overseeing large portfolios of concurrent projects and ongoing service operations

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience in HR technology, HR operations, shared services, or employee service delivery
Experience designing data quality, audit, or monitoring controls for systems, data, or services
Hands-on experience with work management and reporting tools (for example Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Asana, ServiceNow, Workday, Power BI, or Databricks)
Strong AI literacy, including a working understanding of how AI tools can improve work management, reporting, quality assurance, and service delivery
Ability to build, interpret, and communicate metrics and dashboards that drive decisions using data
Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief executives concisely and clearly
Demonstrated ability to lead and influence across teams without direct authority
PMP, SAFe, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certification
Experience working in a highly matrixed environment

WA applicants is $134,434.00 - $188,207.25

Company Description

Butterfly Network, Inc. (NYSE: BFLY) is driving a digital revolution in ultrasound imaging and sensing with its proprietary Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor technology and software solutions. Butterfly first proved its technology in the point-of-care ultrasound market – commercializing the world’s first single-probe, whole-body portable ultrasound device, which is now on its best-selling, third-generation: Butterfly iQ3™. The Company combines its advanced hardware with cloud software and AI, an enterprise workflow solution (Compass AI™) and other offerings to drive adoption of affordable, accessible ultrasound. Butterfly also enables third-party development of imaging AI apps through Butterfly Garden™, its software development kit and AI partnership initiative.

In addition to its medical imaging products, Butterfly Embedded™ is the Company’s Ultrasound-on-Chip™ licensing and co-development program designed to enable a new wave of ultrasound-enabled technologies across non-competitive healthcare markets and beyond. Through Butterfly Embedded™, partners can build and scale novel ultrasound applications powered by Butterfly’s proprietary semiconductor chip and software platform. Butterfly’s innovations have been recognized by Prix Galien USA, Fierce 50, TIME’s Best Inventions and Fast Company’s World Changing Ideas, among other achievements.

We’re a team of bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators ready to shape the future of medical imaging. Let’s build something extraordinary together!

Job Description

In the pivotal role of Senior Project Manager at Butterfly Enterprise, you will lead the implementation of our advanced Butterfly suite of software solutions at critical, large-scale enterprise customer sites. Your leadership will be essential in managing complex projects that are strategic to our company's growth, including the deployment of custom solutions and groundbreaking features. This role calls for a blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and exceptional project management skills to support our most significant and sophisticated enterprise accounts.

As the Senior Project Manager, you will lead the integration of our software across a range of hospital environments, requiring a deep understanding of healthcare workflows, IT systems, and emerging technologies. Your expertise will not only support the successful delivery of complex projects but also help shape the future of healthcare technology implementations at Butterfly Enterprise.

As part of our team, your core responsibilities will be:

Spearhead and manage Butterfly Enterprise implementations for strategic accounts, including large IDNs, partnerships, and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs). This includes crafting project timelines, delivering status updates, and managing risks and issues.
Engage senior stakeholders, both internally and at customer sites, to align project objectives with business goals. This includes leading discussions and presentations with technical and clinical leaders.
Act as a key liaison between customers and Butterfly Network, ensuring top-tier service and satisfaction during software implementation.
Lead, mentor, and inspire project teams while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in project management practices.
Collaborate with internal teams to proactively address future needs, improving the efficiency and effectiveness of complex integration projects.
Contribute meaningfully to the development and ongoing refinement of departmental standards, methodologies, and tools, ensuring alignment with industry best practices.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or advanced degree in a relevant field.
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification required.
Extensive knowledge and experience in hospital IT, medical imaging operations, and healthcare technology project management.
Demonstrated success in managing large-scale, complex projects, preferably in the healthcare technology sector.
Exceptional communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Advanced problem-solving capabilities and innovative thinking.
Proven track record of working effectively in a dynamic, collaborative environment.
Ability to guide, mentor, and develop team members in project management methodologies and best practices.

Ideally, you also have these skills/experiences/attributes (but it’s ok if you don’t!):

PMP certification

Values

Innovation is what we do. Our values are how we make it happen. Butterflies are and believe in…

Patient-Centric Innovators: Our mission is THE mission.
Empowered to Impact: Every voice matters.
One Team, One Goal: Unity fuels progress.
Growth Champions: We embrace challenges.
Action-Oriented Achievers: We follow through, every time.

Location

Butterfly offers a hybrid work model for most positions, with team members spending two or more days a week in the office. While flexibility is key, we value in-person connections that spark creativity and teamwork. Our offices are designed for collaboration, with comfortable workspaces, stocked kitchens, and opportunities to connect with peers.

This is a hybrid position that can be based in Burlington, MA or New York City, NY.

Benefits And Perks

Comprehensive health insurance, encompassing dental and vision coverage, is provided to all our employees. As a health-tech company, we prioritize the well-being of our teams. We also contribute to Health Savings Account (HSA) accounts for all enrolled employees on an annual basis.

The opportunity to build a revolutionary healthcare product and save millions of lives!

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Princeton Quantum Initiative (PQI) seeks an experienced and highly organized Project Manager to support the Quantum Leap Challenge Institute (QLCI): Manufacturable and Resilient Superconducting Quantum Information Systems project.

QLCI is a collaborative, cross-institutional research initiative that brings together expertise in materials, processing, photonics, superconducting qubits, and related disciplines to address critical challenges in developing large-scale quantum processors.

Reporting to the Co-Directors and Executive Director, the Project Manager provides strategic and operational leadership to support the coordination, execution, and advancement of the project. The Project Manager will work closely with faculty leadership, researchers, administrators, partner institutions, funding agencies, and other stakeholders to facilitate collaboration, manage project operations, monitor progress, and ensure effective communication across the initiative.

In addition to supporting the QLCI, the Project Manager will coordinate hiring and personnel-related activities associated with the project and provide broader project and administrative support to PQI.

Responsibilities

Project Management and Coordination

Direct and coordinate project activities in collaboration with Princeton leadership, collaborating institutions, research partners, and funding agencies.
Support the coordination of scientific activities across internal research teams and external collaborators.
Establish and maintain effective project management processes, timelines, and tracking mechanisms.
Use project management tools to monitor progress, deliverables, milestones, risks, and dependencies across individual research groups and the broader project.
Identify potential challenges and facilitate timely resolution of issues that may impact project objectives or deadlines.
Ensure clear and consistent communication regarding project goals, priorities, risks, responsibilities, and progress.
Organize project meetings, workshops, and related events, including developing agendas and preparing and distributing meeting minutes and action items.
Coordinate milestone planning and delivery efforts, including maintaining records, tracking progress, preparing projections, and supporting research teams in developing strategies to achieve milestones.
Coordinate the preparation and submission of monthly, quarterly, and annual reports, project updates, presentations, and other required materials.
Assist with data management, documentation, and dissemination of research results and project information.

Budget and Financial Administration

Monitor project expenditures and support efforts to ensure activities remain within approved budgets.
Work closely with grants managers and administrative staff to support billing, reimbursements, financial tracking, and related processes.
Assist leadership with financial planning, forecasting, and identification of potential budgetary issues.

Procurement, Equipment, and Research Logistics

Coordinate the procurement of specialized equipment, supplies, and services required to support research activities.
Arrange and manage domestic and international shipments of equipment, scientific samples, and other research materials, including freight shipments when necessary.
Coordinate closely with Princeton's Export Control Office and Office of Environmental Health & - Safety to ensure appropriate compliance with applicable University policies and regulations.
Maintain accurate records related to procurement, shipments, equipment, and research materials.

Staff and Fellowship Administration

Coordinate and support all activities related to the hiring of staff, fellows, and other personnel associated with the QLCI and PQI more broadly.
Coordinate the cross-institutional postdoctoral fellowship program, including administrative processes and communication with participating institutions and fellows.
Submit and track University eForms related to PQI personnel, including new hires, additional pay, and terminations.
Process and coordinate Interfolio actions, including reappointments and promotions, for PQI-appointed personnel.
Work closely with Human Resources, faculty leadership, and University administrative offices to ensure employee actions are completed accurately and in a timely manner.

Communications and Web Support

Maintain and update project, faculty, and research group web pages as needed.
Support PQI communications and outreach activities through digital and social media channels.
Assist with the development of newsletters, announcements, promotional materials, and other communications using tools such as Mailchimp, Canva, and related marketing platforms.
Ensure project information is communicated clearly and consistently to internal and external audiences.

Travel and Events

Coordinate travel and logistics for project team members, faculty, researchers, and guests.
Participate in and provide on-site coordination for project meetings, conferences, workshops, and events involving research partners and funding organizations.
Support the planning and execution of collaborative events involving multiple institutions and stakeholders.

Essential

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of related experience.
Minimum of five years of progressively responsible project management or related experience.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational, planning, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
Exceptional attention to detail and demonstrated ability to manage complex projects with multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage projects with limited supervision.
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, hands-on approach to addressing operational and project-related challenges.
Demonstrated professionalism, discretion, diplomacy, and tact when working with diverse stakeholders.
Proven ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with faculty, researchers, administrators, senior leaders, external partners, distinguished guests, and visitors.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
Ability to understand and communicate complex information across diverse technical and professional audiences.
Experience working effectively within an academic research environment.
Experience maintaining and updating websites.
Familiarity with social media and digital communications platforms.
Experience with communications and marketing tools such as Mailchimp, Canva, or similar software.

Preferred

Experience managing complex, multi-institutional research or academic projects.
Experience working in a university, scientific research, or highly technical environment.
Experience supporting federally or externally funded research programs and sponsored projects.
Experience with grant administration, budgeting, procurement, reporting, or compliance.
Experience coordinating personnel activities, hiring processes, or fellowship programs.
Familiarity with project management methodologies and project tracking tools.
Experience coordinating domestic and international research travel, shipments, and events.
Familiarity with quantum science, engineering, physics, materials science, photonics, or another STEM-related research discipline is desirable but not required.

Responsibilities

Lead the planning and execution of technology integration projects resulting from a major banking acquisition.
Develop and manage detailed project roadmaps, workstreams, dependencies, budgets, risks, and milestones for integration initiatives.
Coordinate cross-functional teams responsible for infrastructure consolidation, application rationalization, and operational integration.
